1.zh: 提阿非罗啊，我已经作了前书，论到耶稣开头一切所行所教训的，
1.en: The first book I wrote, Theophilus, concerned all that Jesus began both to do and to teach,

1.zh: 直到他借着圣灵吩咐所拣选的使徒，以后被接上升的日子为止。
1.en: until the day in which he was received up, after he had given commandment through the Holy Spirit to the apostles whom he had chosen.

1.zh: 他受害之后，用许多的凭据将自己活活地显给使徒看，四十天之久向他们显现，讲说　神国的事。
1.en: To these he also showed himself alive after he suffered, by many proofs, appearing to them over a period of forty days and speaking about God’s Kingdom.

1.zh: 耶稣和他们聚集的时候，嘱咐他们说：「不要离开耶路撒冷，要等候父所应许的，就是你们听见我说过的。
1.en: Being assembled together with them, he commanded them, “Don’t depart from Jerusalem, but wait for the promise of the Father, which you heard from me.

1.zh: 约翰是用水施洗，但不多几日，你们要受圣灵的洗。」
1.en: For John indeed baptized in water, but you will be baptized in the Holy Spirit not many days from now.”

1.zh: 他们聚集的时候，问耶稣说：「主啊，你复兴以色列国就在这时候吗？」
1.en: Therefore, when they had come together, they asked him, “Lord, are you now restoring the kingdom to Israel?”

1.zh: 耶稣对他们说：「父凭着自己的权柄所定的时候、日期，不是你们可以知道的。
1.en: He said to them, “It isn’t for you to know times or seasons which the Father has set within his own authority.

1.zh: 但圣灵降临在你们身上，你们就必得着能力，并要在耶路撒冷、犹太全地，和撒马利亚，直到地极，作我的见证。」
1.en: But you will receive power when the Holy Spirit has come upon you. You will be witnesses to me in Jerusalem, in all Judea and Samaria, and to the uttermost parts of the earth.”

1.zh: 说了这话，他们正看的时候，他就被取上升，有一朵云彩把他接去，便看不见他了。
1.en: When he had said these things, as they were looking, he was taken up, and a cloud received him out of their sight.

1.zh: 当他往上去，他们定睛望天的时候，忽然有两个人身穿白衣，站在旁边，说：
1.en: While they were looking steadfastly into the sky as he went, behold, two men stood by them in white clothing,

1.zh: 「加利利人哪，你们为什么站着望天呢？这离开你们被接升天的耶稣，你们见他怎样往天上去，他还要怎样来。」
1.en: who also said, “You men of Galilee, why do you stand looking into the sky? This Jesus, who was received up from you into the sky, will come back in the same way as you saw him going into the sky.”

1.zh: 有一座山，名叫橄榄山，离耶路撒冷不远，约有安息日可走的路程。当下，门徒从那里回耶路撒冷去，
1.en: Then they returned to Jerusalem from the mountain called Olivet, which is near Jerusalem, a Sabbath day’s journey away.

1.zh: 进了城，就上了所住的一间楼房；在那里有彼得、约翰、雅各、安得烈、腓力、多马、巴多罗买、马太、亚勒腓的儿子雅各、奋锐党的西门，和雅各的儿子犹大。
1.en: When they had come in, they went up into the upper room where they were staying, that is Peter, John, James, Andrew, Philip, Thomas, Bartholomew, Matthew, James the son of Alphaeus, Simon the Zealot, and Judas the son of James.

1.zh: 这些人同着几个妇人和耶稣的母亲马利亚，并耶稣的弟兄，都同心合意地恒切祷告。
1.en: All these with one accord continued steadfastly in prayer and supplication, along with the women and Mary the mother of Jesus, and with his brothers.

1.zh: 那时，有许多人[聚会]，约有一百二十名，彼得就在弟兄中间站起来，
1.en: In these days, Peter stood up in the middle of the disciples (and the number of names was about one hundred twenty), and said,

1.zh: 说：「弟兄们！圣灵借大卫的口，在圣经上预言领人捉拿耶稣的犹大，这话是必须应验的。
1.en: “Brothers, it was necessary that this Scripture should be fulfilled, which the Holy Spirit spoke before by the mouth of David concerning Judas, who was guide to those who took Jesus.

1.zh: 他本来列在我们数中，并且在[使徒的]职任上得了一分。
1.en: For he was counted with us, and received his portion in this ministry.

1.zh: 这人用他作恶的工价买了一块田，以后身子仆倒，肚腹崩裂，肠子都流出来。
1.en: Now this man obtained a field with the reward for his wickedness; and falling headlong, his body burst open and all his intestines gushed out.

1.zh: 住在耶路撒冷的众人都知道这事，所以按着他们那里的话给那块田起名叫亚革大马，就是「血田」的意思。
1.en: It became known to everyone who lived in Jerusalem that in their language that field was called ‘Akeldama,’ that is, ‘The field of blood.’

1.zh: 因为诗篇上写着，说： 愿他的住处变为荒场， 无人在内居住； 又说： 愿别人得他的职分。
1.en: For it is written in the book of Psalms, ‘Let his habitation be made desolate. Let no one dwell in it;’ and, ‘Let another take his office.’

1.zh: 所以，主耶稣在我们中间始终出入的时候，
1.en: “Of the men therefore who have accompanied us all the time that the Lord Jesus went in and out among us,

1.zh: 就是从约翰施洗起，直到主离开我们被接上升的日子为止，必须从那常与我们作伴的人中立一位与我们同作耶稣复活的见证。」
1.en: beginning from the baptism of John to the day that he was received up from us, of these one must become a witness with us of his resurrection.”

1.zh: 于是选举两个人，就是那叫做巴撒巴，又称呼犹士都的约瑟，和马提亚。
1.en: They put forward two: Joseph called Barsabbas, who was also called Justus, and Matthias.

1.zh: 众人就祷告说：「主啊，你知道万人的心，求你从这两个人中，指明你所拣选的是谁，叫他得这使徒的位分。这位分犹大已经丢弃，往自己的地方去了。」
1.en: They prayed and said, “You, Lord, who know the hearts of all men, show which one of these two you have chosen
to take part in this ministry and apostleship from which Judas fell away, that he might go to his own place.”

1.zh: 于是众人为他们摇签，摇出马提亚来；他就和十一个使徒同列。
1.en: They drew lots for them, and the lot fell on Matthias; and he was counted with the eleven apostles.

2.zh: 五旬节到了，门徒都聚集在一处。
2.en: Now when the day of Pentecost had come, they were all with one accord in one place.

2.zh: 忽然，从天上有响声下来，好像一阵大风吹过，充满了他们所坐的屋子，
2.en: Suddenly there came from the sky a sound like the rushing of a mighty wind, and it filled all the house where they were sitting.

2.zh: 又有舌头如火焰显现出来，分开落在他们各人头上。
2.en: Tongues like fire appeared and were distributed to them, and one sat on each of them.

2.zh: 他们就都被圣灵充满，按着[圣]灵所赐的口才说起别国的话来。
2.en: They were all filled with the Holy Spirit and began to speak with other languages, as the Spirit gave them the ability to speak.

2.zh: 那时，有虔诚的犹太人从天下各国来，住在耶路撒冷。
2.en: Now there were dwelling in Jerusalem Jews, devout men, from every nation under the sky.

2.zh: 这声音一响，众人都来聚集，各人听见门徒用众人的乡谈说话，就甚纳闷；
2.en: When this sound was heard, the multitude came together and were bewildered, because everyone heard them speaking in his own language.

2.zh: 都惊讶希奇说：「看哪，这说话的不都是加利利人吗？
2.en: They were all amazed and marveled, saying to one another, “Behold, aren’t all these who speak Galileans?

2.zh: 我们各人怎么听见他们说我们生来所用的乡谈呢？
2.en: How do we hear, everyone in our own native language?

2.zh: 我们帕提亚人、米底亚人、以拦人，和住在美索不达米亚、犹太、加帕多家、本都、亚细亚、
2.en: Parthians, Medes, Elamites, and people from Mesopotamia, Judea, Cappadocia, Pontus, Asia,

2.zh: 弗吕家、旁非利亚、埃及的人，并靠近古利奈的利比亚一带地方的人，从罗马来的客旅中，或是犹太人，或是进[犹太]教的人，
2.en: Phrygia, Pamphylia, Egypt, the parts of Libya around Cyrene, visitors from Rome, both Jews and proselytes,

2.zh: 克里特和阿拉伯人，都听见他们用我们的乡谈，讲说　神的大作为。」
2.en: Cretans and Arabians—we hear them speaking in our languages the mighty works of God!”

2.zh: 众人就都惊讶猜疑，彼此说：「这是什么意思呢？」
2.en: They were all amazed and were perplexed, saying to one another, “What does this mean?”

2.zh: 还有人讥诮说：「他们无非是新酒灌满了。」
2.en: Others, mocking, said, “They are filled with new wine.”

2.zh: 彼得和十一个使徒站起，高声说：「犹太人和一切住在耶路撒冷的人哪，这件事你们当知道，也当侧耳听我的话。
2.en: But Peter, standing up with the eleven, lifted up his voice and spoke out to them, “You men of Judea and all you who dwell at Jerusalem, let this be known to you, and listen to my words.

2.zh: 你们想这些人是醉了；其实不是醉了，因为时候刚到巳初。
2.en: For these aren’t drunken, as you suppose, seeing it is only the third hour of the day.

2.zh: 这正是先知约珥所说的：
2.en: But this is what has been spoken through the prophet Joel:

2.zh: 神说：在末后的日子， 我要将我的灵浇灌凡有血气的。 你们的儿女要说预言； 你们的少年人要见异象； 老年人要做异梦。
2.en: ‘It will be in the last days, says God, that I will pour out my Spirit on all flesh. Your sons and your daughters will prophesy. Your young men will see visions. Your old men will dream dreams.

2.zh: 在那些日子， 我要将我的灵浇灌我的仆人和使女， 他们就要说预言。
2.en: Yes, and on my servants and on my handmaidens in those days, I will pour out my Spirit, and they will prophesy.

2.zh: 在天上，我要显出奇事； 在地下，我要显出神迹； 有血，有火，有烟雾。
2.en: I will show wonders in the sky above, and signs on the earth beneath: blood, and fire, and billows of smoke.

2.zh: 日头要变为黑暗， 月亮要变为血； 这都在主大而明显的日子未到以前。
2.en: The sun will be turned into darkness, and the moon into blood, before the great and glorious day of the Lord comes.

2.zh: 到那时候， 凡求告主名的，就必得救。
2.en: It will be that whoever will call on the name of the Lord will be saved.’

2.zh: 「以色列人哪，请听我的话：　神借着拿撒勒人耶稣在你们中间施行异能、奇事、神迹，将他证明出来，这是你们自己知道的。
2.en: “Men of Israel, hear these words! Jesus of Nazareth, a man approved by God to you by mighty works and wonders and signs which God did by him among you, even as you yourselves know,

2.zh: 他既按着　神的定旨先见被交与人，你们就借着无法之人的手，把他钉在十字架上，杀了。
2.en: him, being delivered up by the determined counsel and foreknowledge of God, you have taken by the hand of lawless men, crucified and killed;

2.zh: 神却将死的痛苦解释了，叫他复活，因为他原不能被死拘禁。
2.en: whom God raised up, having freed him from the agony of death, because it was not possible that he should be held by it.

2.zh: 大卫指着他说： 我看见主常在我眼前； 他在我右边，叫我不至于摇动。
2.en: For David says concerning him, ‘I saw the Lord always before my face, for he is on my right hand, that I should not be moved.

2.zh: 所以，我心里欢喜， 我的灵快乐； 并且我的肉身要安居在指望中。
2.en: Therefore my heart was glad, and my tongue rejoiced. Moreover my flesh also will dwell in hope,

2.zh: 因你必不将我的灵魂撇在阴间， 也不叫你的圣者见朽坏。
2.en: because you will not leave my soul in Hades, neither will you allow your Holy One to see decay.

2.zh: 你已将生命的道路指示我， 必叫我因见你的面 得着满足的快乐。
2.en: You made known to me the ways of life. You will make me full of gladness with your presence.’

2.zh: 「弟兄们！先祖大卫的事，我可以明明地对你们说：他死了，也葬埋了，并且他的坟墓直到今日还在我们这里。
2.en: “Brothers, I may tell you freely of the patriarch David, that he both died and was buried, and his tomb is with us to this day.

2.zh: 大卫既是先知，又晓得　神曾向他起誓，要从他的后裔中立一位坐在他的宝座上，
2.en: Therefore, being a prophet, and knowing that God had sworn with an oath to him that of the fruit of his body, according to the flesh, he would raise up the Christ to sit on his throne,

2.zh: 就预先看明这事，讲论基督复活说： 他的灵魂不撇在阴间； 他的肉身也不见朽坏。
2.en: he foreseeing this, spoke about the resurrection of the Christ, that his soul wasn’t left in Hades, and his flesh didn’t see decay.

2.zh: 这耶稣，　神已经叫他复活了，我们都为这事作见证。
2.en: This Jesus God raised up, to which we all are witnesses.

2.zh: 他既被　神的右手高举，又从父受了所应许的圣灵，就把你们所看见所听见的，浇灌下来。
2.en: Being therefore exalted by the right hand of God, and having received from the Father the promise of the Holy Spirit, he has poured out this which you now see and hear.

2.zh: 大卫并没有升到天上，但自己说： 主对我主说： 你坐在我的右边，
2.en: For David didn’t ascend into the heavens, but he says himself, ‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit by my right hand

2.zh: 等我使你仇敌作你的脚凳。
2.en: until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet.”’

2.zh: 「故此，以色列全家当确实地知道，你们钉在十字架上的这位耶稣，　神已经立他为主，为基督了。」
2.en: “Let all the house of Israel therefore know certainly that God has made him both Lord and Christ, this Jesus whom you crucified.”

2.zh: 众人听见这话，觉得扎心，就对彼得和其余的使徒说：「弟兄们，我们当怎样行？」
2.en: Now when they heard this, they were cut to the heart, and said to Peter and the rest of the apostles, “Brothers, what shall we do?”

2.zh: 彼得说：「你们各人要悔改，奉耶稣基督的名受洗，叫你们的罪得赦，就必领受所赐的圣灵；
2.en: Peter said to them, “Repent and be baptized, every one of you, in the name of Jesus Christ for the forgiveness of sins, and you will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.

2.zh: 因为这应许是给你们和你们的儿女，并一切在远方的人，就是主—我们　神所召来的。」
2.en: For the promise is to you and to your children, and to all who are far off, even as many as the Lord our God will call to himself.”

2.zh: 彼得还用许多话作见证，劝勉他们说：「你们当救自己脱离这弯曲的世代。」
2.en: With many other words he testified and exhorted them, saying, “Save yourselves from this crooked generation!”

2.zh: 于是领受他话的人就受了洗。那一天，[门徒]约添了三千人，
2.en: Then those who gladly received his word were baptized. There were added that day about three thousand souls.

2.zh: 都恒心遵守使徒的教训，彼此交接，擘饼，祈祷。
2.en: They continued steadfastly in the apostles’ teaching and fellowship, in the breaking of bread, and prayer.

2.zh: 众人都惧怕；使徒又行了许多奇事神迹。
2.en: Fear came on every soul, and many wonders and signs were done through the apostles.

2.zh: 信的人都在一处，凡物公用，
2.en: All who believed were together, and had all things in common.

2.zh: 并且卖了田产、家业，照各人所需用的分给各人。
2.en: They sold their possessions and goods, and distributed them to all, according as anyone had need.

2.zh: 他们天天同心合意恒切地在殿里，且在家中擘饼，存着欢喜、诚实的心用饭，
2.en: Day by day, continuing steadfastly with one accord in the temple, and breaking bread at home, they took their food with gladness and singleness of heart,

2.zh: 赞美　神，得众民的喜爱。主将得救的人天天加给他们。
2.en: praising God and having favor with all the people. The Lord added to the assembly day by day those who were being saved.

3.zh: 申初祷告的时候，彼得、约翰上[圣]殿去。
3.en: Peter and John were going up into the temple at the hour of prayer, the ninth hour.

3.zh: 有一个人，生来是瘸腿的，天天被人抬来，放在殿的一个门口（那门名叫美[门]），要求进殿的人周济。
3.en: A certain man who was lame from his mother’s womb was being carried, whom they laid daily at the door of the temple which is called Beautiful, to ask gifts for the needy of those who entered into the temple.

3.zh: 他看见彼得、约翰将要进殿，就求他们周济。
3.en: Seeing Peter and John about to go into the temple, he asked to receive gifts for the needy.

3.zh: 彼得、约翰定睛看他；彼得说：「你看我们！」
3.en: Peter, fastening his eyes on him, with John, said, “Look at us.”

3.zh: 那人就留意看他们，指望得着什么。
3.en: He listened to them, expecting to receive something from them.

3.zh: 彼得说：「金银我都没有，只把我所有的给你：我奉拿撒勒人耶稣基督的名，叫你起来行走！」
3.en: But Peter said, “I have no silver or gold, but what I have, that I give you. In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, get up and walk!”

3.zh: 于是拉着他的右手，扶他起来；他的脚和踝子骨立刻健壮了，
3.en: He took him by the right hand and raised him up. Immediately his feet and his ankle bones received strength.

3.zh: 就跳起来，站着，又行走，同他们进了殿，走着，跳着，赞美　神。
3.en: Leaping up, he stood and began to walk. He entered with them into the temple, walking, leaping, and praising God.

3.zh: 百姓都看见他行走，赞美　神；
3.en: All the people saw him walking and praising God.

3.zh: 认得他是那素常坐在殿的美门口求周济的，就因他所遇着的事满心希奇、惊讶。
3.en: They recognized him, that it was he who used to sit begging for gifts for the needy at the Beautiful Gate of the temple. They were filled with wonder and amazement at what had happened to him.

3.zh: 那人正在称为所罗门的廊下，拉着彼得、约翰；众百姓一齐跑到他们那里，很觉希奇。
3.en: As the lame man who was healed held on to Peter and John, all the people ran together to them in the porch that is called Solomon’s, greatly wondering.

3.zh: 彼得看见，就对百姓说：「以色列人哪，为什么把这事当作希奇呢？为什么定睛看我们，以为我们凭自己的能力和虔诚使这人行走呢？
3.en: When Peter saw it, he responded to the people, “You men of Israel, why do you marvel at this man? Why do you fasten your eyes on us, as though by our own power or godliness we had made him walk?

3.zh: 亚伯拉罕、以撒、雅各的　神，就是我们列祖的　神，已经荣耀了他的仆人耶稣；你们却把他交付彼拉多。彼拉多定意要释放他，你们竟在彼拉多面前弃绝了他。
3.en: The God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, the God of our fathers, has glorified his Servant Jesus, whom you delivered up and denied in the presence of Pilate, when he had determined to release him.

3.zh: 你们弃绝了那圣洁公义者，反求着释放一个凶手给你们。
3.en: But you denied the Holy and Righteous One and asked for a murderer to be granted to you,

3.zh: 你们杀了那生命的主，　神却叫他从死里复活了；我们都是为这事作见证。
3.en: and killed the Prince of life, whom God raised from the dead, to which we are witnesses.

3.zh: 我们因信他的名，他的名便叫你们所看见所认识的这人健壮了；正是他所赐的信心，叫这人在你们众人面前全然好了。
3.en: By faith in his name, his name has made this man strong, whom you see and know. Yes, the faith which is through him has given him this perfect soundness in the presence of you all.

3.zh: 弟兄们，我晓得你们做这事是出于不知，你们的官长也是如此。
3.en: “Now, brothers, I know that you did this in ignorance, as did also your rulers.

3.zh: 但　神曾借众先知的口，预言基督将要受害，就这样应验了。
3.en: But the things which God announced by the mouth of all his prophets, that Christ should suffer, he thus fulfilled.

3.zh: 所以，你们当悔改归正，使你们的罪得以涂抹，
3.en: “Repent therefore, and turn again, that your sins may be blotted out, so that there may come times of refreshing from the presence of the Lord,

3.zh: 这样，那安舒的日子就必从主面前来到；主也必差遣所预定给你们的基督（耶稣）降临。
3.en: and that he may send Christ Jesus, who was ordained for you before,

3.zh: 天必留他，等到万物复兴的时候，就是　神从创世以来、借着圣先知的口所说的。
3.en: whom heaven must receive until the times of restoration of all things, which God spoke long ago by the mouth of his holy prophets.

3.zh: 摩西曾说：『主—　神要从你们弟兄中间给你们兴起一位先知像我，凡他向你们所说的，你们都要听从。
3.en: For Moses indeed said to the fathers, ‘The Lord God will raise up a prophet for you from among your brothers, like me. You shall listen to him in all things whatever he says to you.

3.zh: 凡不听从那先知的，必要从民中全然灭绝。』
3.en: It will be that every soul that will not listen to that prophet will be utterly destroyed from among the people.’

3.zh: 从撒母耳以来的众先知，凡说预言的，也都说到这些日子。
3.en: Yes, and all the prophets from Samuel and those who followed after, as many as have spoken, also told of these days.

3.zh: 你们是先知的子孙，也承受　神与你们祖宗所立的约，就是对亚伯拉罕说：『地上万族都要因你的后裔得福。』
3.en: You are the children of the prophets, and of the covenant which God made with our fathers, saying to Abraham, ‘All the families of the earth will be blessed through your offspring.’

3.zh: 神既兴起他的仆人，就先差他到你们这里来，赐福给你们，叫你们各人回转，离开罪恶。」
3.en: God, having raised up his servant Jesus, sent him to you first to bless you, in turning away every one of you from your wickedness.”

4.zh: 使徒对百姓说话的时候，祭司们和守殿官，并撒都该人忽然来了。
4.en: As they spoke to the people, the priests and the captain of the temple and the Sadducees came to them,

4.zh: 因他们教训百姓，本着耶稣，传说死人复活，就很烦恼，
4.en: being upset because they taught the people and proclaimed in Jesus the resurrection from the dead.

4.zh: 于是下手拿住他们；因为天已经晚了，就把他们押到第二天。
4.en: They laid hands on them, and put them in custody until the next day, for it was now evening.

4.zh: 但听道之人有许多信的，男丁数目约到五千。
4.en: But many of those who heard the word believed, and the number of the men came to be about five thousand.

4.zh: 第二天，官府、长老，和文士在耶路撒冷聚会，
4.en: In the morning, their rulers, elders, and scribes were gathered together in Jerusalem.

4.zh: 又有大祭司亚那和该亚法、约翰、亚历山大，并大祭司的亲族都在那里，
4.en: Annas the high priest was there, with Caiaphas, John, Alexander, and as many as were relatives of the high priest.

4.zh: 叫使徒站在当中，就问他们说：「你们用什么能力，奉谁的名做这事呢？」
4.en: When they had stood Peter and John in the middle of them, they inquired, “By what power, or in what name, have you done this?”

4.zh: 那时彼得被圣灵充满，对他们说：
4.en: Then Peter, filled with the Holy Spirit, said to them, “You rulers of the people and elders of Israel,

4.zh: 「治民的官府和长老啊，倘若今日因为在残疾人身上所行的善事查问我们他是怎么得了痊愈，
4.en: if we are examined today concerning a good deed done to a crippled man, by what means this man has been healed,

4.zh: 你们众人和以色列百姓都当知道，站在你们面前的这人得痊愈是因你们所钉十字架、　神叫他从死里复活的拿撒勒人耶稣基督的名。
4.en: may it be known to you all, and to all the people of Israel, that in the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, whom you crucified, whom God raised from the dead, this man stands here before you whole in him.

4.zh: 他是 你们匠人所弃的石头， 已成了房角的头块石头。
4.en: He is ‘the stone which was regarded as worthless by you, the builders, which has become the head of the corner.’

4.zh: 除他以外，别无拯救；因为在天下人间，没有赐下别的名，我们可以靠着得救。」
4.en: There is salvation in no one else, for there is no other name under heaven that is given among men, by which we must be saved!”

4.zh: 他们见彼得、约翰的胆量，又看出他们原是没有学问的小民，就希奇，认明他们是跟过耶稣的；
4.en: Now when they saw the boldness of Peter and John, and had perceived that they were unlearned and ignorant men, they marveled. They recognized that they had been with Jesus.

4.zh: 又看见那治好了的人和他们一同站着，就无话可驳。
4.en: Seeing the man who was healed standing with them, they could say nothing against it.

4.zh: 于是吩咐他们从公会出去，就彼此商议说：
4.en: But when they had commanded them to go aside out of the council, they conferred among themselves,

4.zh: 「我们当怎样办这两个人呢？因为他们诚然行了一件明显的神迹，凡住耶路撒冷的人都知道，我们也不能说没有。
4.en: saying, “What shall we do to these men? Because indeed a notable miracle has been done through them, as can be plainly seen by all who dwell in Jerusalem, and we can’t deny it.

4.zh: 惟恐这事越发传扬在民间，我们必须恐吓他们，叫他们不再奉这名对人讲论。」
4.en: But so that this spreads no further among the people, let’s threaten them, that from now on they don’t speak to anyone in this name.”

4.zh: 于是叫了他们来，禁止他们总不可奉耶稣的名讲论教训人。
4.en: They called them, and commanded them not to speak at all nor teach in the name of Jesus.

4.zh: 彼得、约翰说：「听从你们，不听从　神，这在　神面前合理不合理，你们自己酌量吧！
4.en: But Peter and John answered them, “Whether it is right in the sight of God to listen to you rather than to God, judge for yourselves,

4.zh: 我们所看见所听见的，不能不说。」
4.en: for we can’t help telling the things which we saw and heard.”

4.zh: 官长为百姓的缘故，想不出法子刑罚他们，又恐吓一番，把他们释放了。这是因众人为所行的奇事都归荣耀与　神。
4.en: When they had further threatened them, they let them go, finding no way to punish them, because of the people; for everyone glorified God for that which was done.

4.zh: 原来借着神迹医好的那人有四十多岁了。
4.en: For the man on whom this miracle of healing was performed was more than forty years old.

4.zh: 二人既被释放，就到会友那里去，把祭司长和长老所说的话都告诉他们。
4.en: Being let go, they came to their own company and reported all that the chief priests and the elders had said to them.

4.zh: 他们听见了，就同心合意地高声向　神说：「主啊！你是造天、地、海，和其中万物的，
4.en: When they heard it, they lifted up their voice to God with one accord and said, “O Lord, you are God, who made the sky, the earth, the sea, and all that is in them;

4.zh: 你曾借着圣灵，[托]你仆人—我们祖宗大卫的口，说： 外邦为什么争闹？ 万民为什么谋算虚妄的事？
4.en: who by the mouth of your servant David, said, ‘Why do the nations rage, and the peoples plot a vain thing?

4.zh: 世上的君王一齐起来， 臣宰也聚集， 要敌挡主， 并主的受膏者。
4.en: The kings of the earth take a stand, and the rulers plot together, against the Lord, and against his Christ.’

4.zh: 希律和本丢·彼拉多，外邦人和以色列民，果然在这城里聚集，要攻打你所膏的圣仆耶稣，
4.en: “For truly, both Herod and Pontius Pilate, with the Gentiles and the people of Israel, were gathered together against your holy servant Jesus, whom you anointed,

4.zh: 成就你手和你意旨所预定必有的事。
4.en: to do whatever your hand and your counsel foreordained to happen.

4.zh: 他们恐吓我们，现在求主鉴察，一面叫你仆人大放胆量讲你的道，一面伸出你的手来医治疾病，并且使神迹奇事因着你圣仆耶稣的名行出来。」
4.en: Now, Lord, look at their threats, and grant to your servants to speak your word with all boldness,
while you stretch out your hand to heal; and that signs and wonders may be done through the name of your holy Servant Jesus.”

4.zh: 祷告完了，聚会的地方震动，他们就都被圣灵充满，放胆讲论　神的道。
4.en: When they had prayed, the place was shaken where they were gathered together. They were all filled with the Holy Spirit, and they spoke the word of God with boldness.

4.zh: 那许多信的人都是一心一意的，没有一人说他的东西有一样是自己的，都是大家公用。
4.en: The multitude of those who believed were of one heart and soul. Not one of them claimed that anything of the things which he possessed was his own, but they had all things in common.

4.zh: 使徒大有能力，见证主耶稣复活；众人也都蒙大恩。
4.en: With great power, the apostles gave their testimony of the resurrection of the Lord Jesus. Great grace was on them all.

4.zh: 内中也没有一个缺乏的；因为人人将田产房屋都卖了，把所卖的价银拿来，
4.en: For neither was there among them any who lacked, for as many as were owners of lands or houses sold them, and brought the proceeds of the things that were sold,

4.zh: 放在使徒脚前，照各人所需用的，分给各人。
4.en: and laid them at the apostles’ feet; and distribution was made to each, according as anyone had need.

4.zh: 有一个利未人，生在塞浦路斯，名叫约瑟，使徒称他为巴拿巴（巴拿巴翻出来就是劝慰子）。
4.en: Joses, who by the apostles was also called Barnabas (which is, being interpreted, Son of Encouragement), a Levite, a man of Cyprus by race,

4.zh: 他有田地，也卖了，把价银拿来，放在使徒脚前。
4.en: having a field, sold it and brought the money and laid it at the apostles’ feet.

5.zh: 有一个人，名叫亚拿尼亚，同他的妻子撒非喇卖了田产，
5.en: But a certain man named Ananias, with Sapphira his wife, sold a possession,

5.zh: 把价银私自留下几分，他的妻子也知道，其余的几分拿来放在使徒脚前。
5.en: and kept back part of the price, his wife also being aware of it, then brought a certain part and laid it at the apostles’ feet.

5.zh: 彼得说：「亚拿尼亚！为什么撒但充满了你的心，叫你欺哄圣灵，把田地的价银私自留下几分呢？
5.en: But Peter said, “Ananias, why has Satan filled your heart to lie to the Holy Spirit and to keep back part of the price of the land?

5.zh: 田地还没有卖，不是你自己的吗？既卖了，价银不是你作主吗？你怎么心里起这意念呢？你不是欺哄人，是欺哄　神了。」
5.en: While you kept it, didn’t it remain your own? After it was sold, wasn’t it in your power? How is it that you have conceived this thing in your heart? You haven’t lied to men, but to God.”

5.zh: 亚拿尼亚听见这话，就仆倒，断了气；听见的人都甚惧怕。
5.en: Ananias, hearing these words, fell down and died. Great fear came on all who heard these things.

5.zh: 有些少年人起来，把他包裹，抬出去埋葬了。
5.en: The young men arose and wrapped him up, and they carried him out and buried him.

5.zh: 约过了三小时，他的妻子进来，还不知道这事。
5.en: About three hours later, his wife, not knowing what had happened, came in.

5.zh: 彼得对她说：「你告诉我，你们卖田地的价银就是这些吗？」她说：「就是这些。」
5.en: Peter answered her, “Tell me whether you sold the land for so much.” She said, “Yes, for so much.”

5.zh: 彼得说：「你们为什么同心试探主的灵呢？埋葬你丈夫之人的脚已到门口，他们也要把你抬出去。」
5.en: But Peter asked her, “How is it that you have agreed together to tempt the Spirit of the Lord? Behold, the feet of those who have buried your husband are at the door, and they will carry you out.”

5.zh: 妇人立刻仆倒在彼得脚前，断了气。那些少年人进来，见她已经死了，就抬出去，埋在她丈夫旁边。
5.en: She fell down immediately at his feet and died. The young men came in and found her dead, and they carried her out and buried her by her husband.

5.zh: 全教会和听见这事的人都甚惧怕。
5.en: Great fear came on the whole assembly, and on all who heard these things.

5.zh: 主借使徒的手在民间行了许多神迹奇事；他们都同心合意地在所罗门的廊下。
5.en: By the hands of the apostles many signs and wonders were done among the people. They were all with one accord in Solomon’s porch.

5.zh: 其余的人没有一个敢贴近他们，百姓却尊重他们。
5.en: None of the rest dared to join them; however, the people honored them.

5.zh: 信而归主的人越发增添，连男带女很多。
5.en: More believers were added to the Lord, multitudes of both men and women.

5.zh: 甚至有人将病人抬到街上，放在床上或褥子上，指望彼得过来的时候，或者得他的影儿照在什么人身上。
5.en: They even carried out the sick into the streets and laid them on cots and mattresses, so that as Peter came by, at least his shadow might overshadow some of them.

5.zh: 还有许多人带着病人和被污鬼缠磨的，从耶路撒冷四围的城邑来，全都得了医治。
5.en: The multitude also came together from the cities around Jerusalem, bringing sick people and those who were tormented by unclean spirits; and they were all healed.

5.zh: 大祭司和他的一切同人，就是撒都该教门的人，都起来，满心忌恨，
5.en: But the high priest rose up, and all those who were with him (which is the sect of the Sadducees), and they were filled with jealousy

5.zh: 就下手拿住使徒，收在外监。
5.en: and laid hands on the apostles, then put them in public custody.

5.zh: 但主的使者夜间开了监门，领他们出来，
5.en: But an angel of the Lord opened the prison doors by night, and brought them out and said,

5.zh: 说：「你们去站在殿里，把这生命的道都讲给百姓听。」
5.en: “Go stand and speak in the temple to the people all the words of this life.”

5.zh: 使徒听了这话，天将亮的时候就进殿里去教训人。大祭司和他的同人来了，叫齐公会的人和以色列族的众长老，就差人到监里去，要把使徒提出来。
5.en: When they heard this, they entered into the temple about daybreak and taught. But the high priest and those who were with him came and called the council together, with all the senate of the children of Israel, and sent to the prison to have them brought.

5.zh: 但差役到了，不见他们在监里，就回来禀报说：
5.en: But the officers who came didn’t find them in the prison. They returned and reported,

5.zh: 「我们看见监牢关得极妥当，看守的人也站在门外；及至开了门，里面一个人都不见。」
5.en: “We found the prison shut and locked, and the guards standing before the doors, but when we opened them, we found no one inside!”

5.zh: 守殿官和祭司长听见这话，心里犯难，不知这事将来如何。
5.en: Now when the high priest, the captain of the temple, and the chief priests heard these words, they were very perplexed about them and what might become of this.

5.zh: 有一个人来禀报说：「你们收在监里的人，现在站在殿里教训百姓。」
5.en: One came and told them, “Behold, the men whom you put in prison are in the temple, standing and teaching the people.”

5.zh: 于是守殿官和差役去带使徒来，并没有用强暴，因为怕百姓用石头打他们。
5.en: Then the captain went with the officers, and brought them without violence, for they were afraid that the people might stone them.

5.zh: 带到了，便叫使徒站在公会前；大祭司问他们说：
5.en: When they had brought them, they set them before the council. The high priest questioned them,

5.zh: 「我们不是严严地禁止你们，不可奉这名教训人吗？你们倒把你们的道理充满了耶路撒冷，想要叫这人的血归到我们身上！」
5.en: saying, “Didn’t we strictly command you not to teach in this name? Behold, you have filled Jerusalem with your teaching, and intend to bring this man’s blood on us.”

5.zh: 彼得和众使徒回答说：「顺从　神，不顺从人，是应当的。
5.en: But Peter and the apostles answered, “We must obey God rather than men.

5.zh: 你们挂在木头上杀害的耶稣，我们祖宗的　神已经叫他复活。
5.en: The God of our fathers raised up Jesus, whom you killed, hanging him on a tree.

5.zh: 神且用右手将他高举，叫他作君王，作救主，将悔改的心和赦罪的恩赐给以色列人。
5.en: God exalted him with his right hand to be a Prince and a Savior, to give repentance to Israel, and remission of sins.

5.zh: 我们为这事作见证；　神赐给顺从之人的圣灵也为这事作见证。」
5.en: We are his witnesses of these things; and so also is the Holy Spirit, whom God has given to those who obey him.”

5.zh: 公会的人听见就极其恼怒，想要杀他们。
5.en: But they, when they heard this, were cut to the heart, and were determined to kill them.

5.zh: 但有一个法利赛人，名叫迦玛列，是众百姓所敬重的教法师，在公会中站起来，吩咐人把使徒暂且带到外面去，
5.en: But one stood up in the council, a Pharisee named Gamaliel, a teacher of the law, honored by all the people, and commanded to put the apostles out for a little while.

5.zh: 就对众人说：「以色列人哪，论到这些人，你们应当小心怎样办理。
5.en: He said to them, “You men of Israel, be careful concerning these men, what you are about to do.

5.zh: 从前杜达起来，自夸为大，附从他的人约有四百，他被杀后，附从他的全都散了，归于无有。
5.en: For before these days Theudas rose up, making himself out to be somebody; to whom a number of men, about four hundred, joined themselves. He was slain; and all, as many as obeyed him, were dispersed and came to nothing.

5.zh: 此后，报名上册的时候，又有加利利的犹大起来，引诱些百姓跟从他；他也灭亡，附从他的人也都四散了。
5.en: After this man, Judas of Galilee rose up in the days of the enrollment, and drew away some people after him. He also perished, and all, as many as obeyed him, were scattered abroad.

5.zh: 现在，我劝你们不要管这些人，任凭他们吧！他们所谋的、所行的，若是出于人，必要败坏；
5.en: Now I tell you, withdraw from these men and leave them alone. For if this counsel or this work is of men, it will be overthrown.

5.zh: 若是出于　神，你们就不能败坏他们，恐怕你们倒是攻击　神了。」
5.en: But if it is of God, you will not be able to overthrow it, and you would be found even to be fighting against God!”

5.zh: 公会的人听从了他，便叫使徒来，把他们打了，又吩咐他们不可奉耶稣的名讲道，就把他们释放了。
5.en: They agreed with him. Summoning the apostles, they beat them and commanded them not to speak in the name of Jesus, and let them go.

5.zh: 他们离开公会，心里欢喜，因被算是配为这名受辱。
5.en: They therefore departed from the presence of the council, rejoicing that they were counted worthy to suffer dishonor for Jesus’ name.

5.zh: 他们就每日在殿里、在家里不住地教训人，传耶稣是基督。
5.en: Every day, in the temple and at home, they never stopped teaching and preaching Jesus, the Christ.

6.zh: 那时，门徒增多，有说希腊话的犹太人向希伯来人发怨言，因为在天天的供给上忽略了他们的寡妇。
6.en: Now in those days, when the number of the disciples was multiplying, a complaint arose from the Hellenists against the Hebrews, because their widows were neglected in the daily service.

6.zh: 十二使徒叫众门徒来，对他们说：「我们撇下　神的道去管理饭食，原是不合宜的。
6.en: The twelve summoned the multitude of the disciples and said, “It is not appropriate for us to forsake the word of God and serve tables.

6.zh: 所以弟兄们，当从你们中间选出七个有好名声、被[圣]灵充满、智慧充足的人，我们就派他们管理这事。
6.en: Therefore, select from among you, brothers, seven men of good report, full of the Holy Spirit and of wisdom, whom we may appoint over this business.

6.zh: 但我们要专心以祈祷、传道为事。」
6.en: But we will continue steadfastly in prayer and in the ministry of the word.”

6.zh: 大众都喜悦这话，就拣选了司提反，乃是大有信心、圣灵充满的人，又拣选腓利、伯罗哥罗、尼迦挪、提门、巴米拿，并进[犹太]教的安提阿人尼哥拉，
6.en: These words pleased the whole multitude. They chose Stephen, a man full of faith and of the Holy Spirit, Philip, Prochorus, Nicanor, Timon, Parmenas, and Nicolaus, a proselyte of Antioch,

6.zh: 叫他们站在使徒面前。使徒祷告了，就按手在他们头上。
6.en: whom they set before the apostles. When they had prayed, they laid their hands on them.

6.zh: 神的道兴旺起来；在耶路撒冷门徒数目加增的甚多，也有许多祭司信从了这道。
6.en: The word of God increased and the number of the disciples greatly multiplied in Jerusalem. A great company of the priests were obedient to the faith.

6.zh: 司提反满得恩惠、能力，在民间行了大奇事和神迹。
6.en: Stephen, full of faith and power, performed great wonders and signs among the people.

6.zh: 当时有称利百地拿会堂的几个人，并有古利奈、亚历山大、基利家、亚细亚各处会堂的几个人，都起来和司提反辩论。
6.en: But some of those who were of the synagogue called “The Libertines”, and of the Cyrenians, of the Alexandrians, and of those of Cilicia and Asia arose, disputing with Stephen.

6.zh: 司提反是以智慧和[圣]灵说话，众人敌挡不住，
6.en: They weren’t able to withstand the wisdom and the Spirit by which he spoke.

6.zh: 就买出人来说：「我们听见他说谤 摩西和　神的话。」
6.en: Then they secretly induced men to say, “We have heard him speak blasphemous words against Moses and God.”

6.zh: 他们又耸动了百姓、长老，并文士，就忽然来捉拿他，把他带到公会去，
6.en: They stirred up the people, the elders, and the scribes, and came against him and seized him, then brought him in to the council,

6.zh: 设下假见证，说：「这个人说话，不住地糟践圣所和律法。
6.en: and set up false witnesses who said, “This man never stops speaking blasphemous words against this holy place and the law.

6.zh: 我们曾听见他说，这拿撒勒人耶稣要毁坏此地，也要改变摩西所交给我们的规条。」
6.en: For we have heard him say that this Jesus of Nazareth will destroy this place, and will change the customs which Moses delivered to us.”

6.zh: 在公会里坐着的人都定睛看他，见他的面貌，好像天使的面貌。
6.en: All who sat in the council, fastening their eyes on him, saw his face like it was the face of an angel.

7.zh: 大祭司就说：「这些事果然有吗？」
7.en: The high priest said, “Are these things so?”

7.zh: 司提反说：「诸位父兄请听！当日我们的祖宗亚伯拉罕在美索不达米亚还未住哈兰的时候，荣耀的　神向他显现，
7.en: He said, “Brothers and fathers, listen. The God of glory appeared to our father Abraham when he was in Mesopotamia, before he lived in Haran,

7.zh: 对他说：『你要离开本地和亲族，往我所要指示你的地方去。』
7.en: and said to him, ‘Get out of your land and away from your relatives, and come into a land which I will show you.’

7.zh: 他就离开迦勒底人之地，住在哈兰。他父亲死了以后，　[神]使他从那里搬到你们现在所住之地。
7.en: Then he came out of the land of the Chaldaeans and lived in Haran. From there, when his father was dead, God moved him into this land where you are now living.

7.zh: 在这地方，　神并没有给他产业，连立足之地也没有给他；但应许要将这地赐给他和他的后裔为业；那时他还没有儿子。
7.en: He gave him no inheritance in it, no, not so much as to set his foot on. He promised that he would give it to him for a possession, and to his offspring after him, when he still had no child.

7.zh: 神说：『他的后裔必寄居外邦，那里的人要叫他们作奴仆，苦待他们四百年。』
7.en: God spoke in this way: that his offspring would live as aliens in a strange land, and that they would be enslaved and mistreated for four hundred years.

7.zh: 神又说：『使他们作奴仆的那国，我要惩罚。以后他们要出来，在这地方事奉我。』
7.en: ‘I will judge the nation to which they will be in bondage,’ said God, ‘and after that they will come out and serve me in this place.’

7.zh: 神又赐他割礼的约。于是[亚伯拉罕]生了以撒，第八日给他行了割礼。以撒生雅各；雅各生十二位先祖。
7.en: He gave him the covenant of circumcision. So Abraham became the father of Isaac, and circumcised him the eighth day. Isaac became the father of Jacob, and Jacob became the father of the twelve patriarchs.

7.zh: 「先祖嫉妒约瑟，把他卖到埃及去；　神却与他同在，
7.en: “The patriarchs, moved with jealousy against Joseph, sold him into Egypt. God was with him

7.zh: 救他脱离一切苦难，又使他在埃及王法老面前得恩典，有智慧。法老就派他作埃及国的宰相兼管全家。
7.en: and delivered him out of all his afflictions, and gave him favor and wisdom before Pharaoh, king of Egypt. He made him governor over Egypt and all his house.

7.zh: 后来埃及和迦南全地遭遇饥荒，大受艰难，我们的祖宗就绝了粮。
7.en: Now a famine came over all the land of Egypt and Canaan, and great affliction. Our fathers found no food.

7.zh: 雅各听见在埃及有粮，就打发我们的祖宗初次往那里去。
7.en: But when Jacob heard that there was grain in Egypt, he sent out our fathers the first time.

7.zh: 第二次约瑟与弟兄们相认，他的亲族也被法老知道了。
7.en: On the second time Joseph was made known to his brothers, and Joseph’s family was revealed to Pharaoh.

7.zh: 约瑟就打发弟兄请父亲雅各和全家七十五个人都来。
7.en: Joseph sent and summoned Jacob his father and all his relatives, seventy-five souls.

7.zh: 于是雅各下了埃及，后来他和我们的祖宗都死在那里；
7.en: Jacob went down into Egypt and he died, himself and our fathers;

7.zh: 又被带到示剑，葬于亚伯拉罕在示剑用银子从哈抹子孙买来的坟墓里。
7.en: and they were brought back to Shechem and laid in the tomb that Abraham bought for a price in silver from the children of Hamor of Shechem.

7.zh: 「及至　神应许亚伯拉罕的日期将到，以色列民在埃及兴盛众多，
7.en: “But as the time of the promise came close which God had sworn to Abraham, the people grew and multiplied in Egypt,

7.zh: 直到有不晓得约瑟的新王兴起。
7.en: until there arose a different king who didn’t know Joseph.

7.zh: 他用诡计待我们的宗族，苦害我们的祖宗，叫他们丢弃婴孩，使婴孩不能存活。
7.en: The same took advantage of our race and mistreated our fathers, and forced them to abandon their babies, so that they wouldn’t stay alive.

7.zh: 那时，摩西生下来，俊美非凡，在他父亲家里抚养了三个月。
7.en: At that time Moses was born, and was exceedingly handsome to God. He was nourished three months in his father’s house.

7.zh: 他被丢弃的时候，法老的女儿拾了去，养为自己的儿子。
7.en: When he was abandoned, Pharaoh’s daughter took him up and reared him as her own son.

7.zh: 摩西学了埃及人一切的学问，说话行事都有才能。
7.en: Moses was instructed in all the wisdom of the Egyptians. He was mighty in his words and works.

7.zh: 「他将到四十岁，心中起意去看望他的弟兄以色列人；
7.en: But when he was forty years old, it came into his heart to visit his brothers, the children of Israel.

7.zh: [到了那里]，见他们一个人受冤屈，就护庇他，为那受欺压的人报仇，打死了那埃及人。
7.en: Seeing one of them suffer wrong, he defended him and avenged him who was oppressed, striking the Egyptian.

7.zh: 他以为弟兄必明白　神是借他的手搭救他们；他们却不明白。
7.en: He supposed that his brothers understood that God, by his hand, was giving them deliverance; but they didn’t understand.

7.zh: 第二天，遇见两个[以色列]人争斗，就劝他们和睦，说：『你们二位是弟兄，为什么彼此欺负呢？』
7.en: “The day following, he appeared to them as they fought, and urged them to be at peace again, saying, ‘Sirs, you are brothers. Why do you wrong one another?’

7.zh: 那欺负邻舍的把他推开，说：『谁立你作我们的首领和审判官呢？
7.en: But he who did his neighbor wrong pushed him away, saying, ‘Who made you a ruler and a judge over us?

7.zh: 难道你要杀我，像昨天杀那埃及人吗？』
7.en: Do you want to kill me as you killed the Egyptian yesterday?’

7.zh: 摩西听见这话就逃走了，寄居于米甸；在那里生了两个儿子。
7.en: Moses fled at this saying, and became a stranger in the land of Midian, where he became the father of two sons.

7.zh: 「过了四十年，在西奈山的旷野，有一位天使从荆棘火焰中向摩西显现。
7.en: “When forty years were fulfilled, an angel of the Lord appeared to him in the wilderness of Mount Sinai, in a flame of fire in a bush.

7.zh: 摩西见了那异象，便觉希奇，正进前观看的时候，有主的声音说：
7.en: When Moses saw it, he wondered at the sight. As he came close to see, the voice of the Lord came to him,

7.zh: 『我是你列祖的　神，就是亚伯拉罕的　神，以撒的　神，雅各的　神。』摩西战战兢兢，不敢观看。
7.en: ‘I am the God of your fathers: the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.’ Moses trembled and dared not look.

7.zh: 主对他说：『把你脚上的鞋脱下来，因为你所站之地是圣地。
7.en: The Lord said to him, ‘Take off your sandals, for the place where you stand is holy ground.

7.zh: 我的百姓在埃及所受的困苦，我实在看见了，他们悲叹的声音，我也听见了。我下来要救他们。你来！我要差你往埃及去。』
7.en: I have surely seen the affliction of my people who are in Egypt, and have heard their groaning. I have come down to deliver them. Now come, I will send you into Egypt.’

7.zh: 这摩西就是百姓弃绝说『谁立你作我们的首领和审判官』的；　神却借那在荆棘中显现之使者的手差派他作首领、作救赎的。
7.en: “This Moses whom they refused, saying, ‘Who made you a ruler and a judge?’—God has sent him as both a ruler and a deliverer by the hand of the angel who appeared to him in the bush.

7.zh: 这人领百姓出来，在埃及，在红海，在旷野，四十年间行了奇事神迹。
7.en: This man led them out, having worked wonders and signs in Egypt, in the Red Sea, and in the wilderness for forty years.

7.zh: 那曾对以色列人说『　神要从你们弟兄中间给你们兴起一位先知像我』的，就是这位摩西。
7.en: This is that Moses who said to the children of Israel, ‘The Lord our God will raise up a prophet for you from among your brothers, like me.’

7.zh: 这人曾在旷野会中和西奈山上，与那对他说话的天使同在，又与我们的祖宗同在，并且领受活泼的圣言传给我们。
7.en: This is he who was in the assembly in the wilderness with the angel that spoke to him on Mount Sinai, and with our fathers, who received living revelations to give to us,

7.zh: 我们的祖宗不肯听从，反弃绝他，心里归向埃及，
7.en: to whom our fathers wouldn’t be obedient, but rejected him and turned back in their hearts to Egypt,

7.zh: 对亚伦说：『你且为我们造些神像，在我们前面引路；因为领我们出埃及地的那个摩西，我们不知道他遭了什么事。』
7.en: saying to Aaron, ‘Make us gods that will go before us, for as for this Moses who led us out of the land of Egypt, we don’t know what has become of him.’

7.zh: 那时，他们造了一个牛犊，又拿祭物献给那像，欢喜自己手中的工作。
7.en: They made a calf in those days, and brought a sacrifice to the idol, and rejoiced in the works of their hands.

7.zh: 神就转脸不顾，任凭他们事奉天上的日月星辰，正如先知书上所写的说： 以色列家啊， 你们四十年间在旷野， 岂是将牺牲和祭物献给我吗？
7.en: But God turned away and gave them up to serve the army of the sky, as it is written in the book of the prophets, ‘Did you offer to me slain animals and sacrifices forty years in the wilderness, O house of Israel?

7.zh: 你们抬着摩洛的帐幕和理番神的星， 就是你们所造为要敬拜的像。 [因此]，我要把你们迁到巴比伦外去。
7.en: You took up the tabernacle of Moloch, the star of your god Rephan, the figures which you made to worship, so I will carry you away beyond Babylon.’

7.zh: 「我们的祖宗在旷野，有法柜的帐幕，是　[神]吩咐摩西叫他照所看见的样式做的。
7.en: “Our fathers had the tabernacle of the testimony in the wilderness, even as he who spoke to Moses commanded him to make it according to the pattern that he had seen;

7.zh: 这帐幕，我们的祖宗相继承受。当　神在他们面前赶出外邦人去的时候，他们同约书亚把帐幕搬进承受为业之地，直存到大卫的日子。
7.en: which also our fathers, in their turn, brought in with Joshua when they entered into the possession of the nations whom God drove out before the face of our fathers to the days of David,

7.zh: 大卫在　神面前蒙恩，祈求为雅各的　神预备居所；
7.en: who found favor in the sight of God, and asked to find a habitation for the God of Jacob.

7.zh: 却是所罗门为　神造成殿宇。
7.en: But Solomon built him a house.

7.zh: 其实，至高者并不住人手所造的，就如先知所言：
7.en: However, the Most High doesn’t dwell in temples made with hands, as the prophet says,

7.zh: 主说：天是我的座位， 地是我的脚凳； 你们要为我造何等的殿宇？ 哪里是我安息的地方呢？
7.en: ‘heaven is my throne, and the earth a footstool for my feet. What kind of house will you build me?’ says the Lord. ‘Or what is the place of my rest?

7.zh: 这一切不都是我手所造的吗？
7.en: Didn’t my hand make all these things?’

7.zh: 「你们这硬着颈项、心与耳未受割礼的人，常时抗拒圣灵！你们的祖宗怎样，你们也怎样。
7.en: “You stiff-necked and uncircumcised in heart and ears, you always resist the Holy Spirit! As your fathers did, so you do.

7.zh: 哪一个先知不是你们祖宗逼迫呢？他们也把预先传说那义者要来的人杀了；如今你们又把那义者卖了，杀了。
7.en: Which of the prophets didn’t your fathers persecute? They killed those who foretold the coming of the Righteous One, of whom you have now become betrayers and murderers.

7.zh: 你们受了天使所传的律法，竟不遵守。」
7.en: You received the law as it was ordained by angels, and didn’t keep it!”

7.zh: 众人听见这话就极其恼怒，向司提反咬牙切齿。
7.en: Now when they heard these things, they were cut to the heart, and they gnashed at him with their teeth.

7.zh: 但司提反被圣灵充满，定睛望天，看见　神的荣耀，又看见耶稣站在　神的右边，
7.en: But he, being full of the Holy Spirit, looked up steadfastly into heaven and saw the glory of God, and Jesus standing on the right hand of God,

7.zh: 就说：「我看见天开了，人子站在　神的右边。」
7.en: and said, “Behold, I see the heavens opened and the Son of Man standing at the right hand of God!”

7.zh: 众人大声喊叫，捂着耳朵，齐心拥上前去，
7.en: But they cried out with a loud voice and stopped their ears, then rushed at him with one accord.

7.zh: 把他推到城外，用石头打他。作见证的人把衣裳放在一个少年人名叫扫罗的脚前。
7.en: They threw him out of the city and stoned him. The witnesses placed their garments at the feet of a young man named Saul.

7.zh: 他们正用石头打的时候，司提反呼吁[主]说：「求主耶稣接收我的灵魂！」
7.en: They stoned Stephen as he called out, saying, “Lord Jesus, receive my spirit!”

7.zh: 又跪下大声喊着说：「主啊，不要将这罪归于他们！」说了这话，就睡了。扫罗也喜悦他被害。
7.en: He kneeled down and cried with a loud voice, “Lord, don’t hold this sin against them!” When he had said this, he fell asleep.

8.zh: 从这日起，耶路撒冷的教会大遭逼迫，除了使徒以外，门徒都分散在犹太和撒马利亚各处。
8.en: Saul was consenting to his death. A great persecution arose against the assembly which was in Jerusalem in that day. They were all scattered abroad throughout the regions of Judea and Samaria, except for the apostles.

8.zh: 有虔诚的人把司提反埋葬了，为他捶胸大哭。
8.en: Devout men buried Stephen and lamented greatly over him.

8.zh: 扫罗却残害教会，进各人的家，拉着男女下在监里。
8.en: But Saul ravaged the assembly, entering into every house and dragged both men and women off to prison.

8.zh: 那些分散的人往各处去传道。
8.en: Therefore those who were scattered abroad went around preaching the word.

8.zh: 腓利下撒马利亚城去，宣讲基督。
8.en: Philip went down to the city of Samaria and proclaimed to them the Christ.

8.zh: 众人听见了，又看见腓利所行的神迹，就同心合意地听从他的话。
8.en: The multitudes listened with one accord to the things that were spoken by Philip when they heard and saw the signs which he did.

8.zh: 因为有许多人被污鬼附着，那些鬼大声呼叫，从他们身上出来；还有许多瘫痪的、瘸腿的，都得了医治。
8.en: For unclean spirits came out of many of those who had them. They came out, crying with a loud voice. Many who had been paralyzed and lame were healed.

8.zh: 在那城里，就大有欢喜。
8.en: There was great joy in that city.

8.zh: 有一个人，名叫西门，向来在那城里行邪术，妄自尊大，使撒马利亚的百姓惊奇；
8.en: But there was a certain man, Simon by name, who used to practice sorcery in the city and amazed the people of Samaria, making himself out to be some great one,

8.zh: 无论大小都听从他，说：「这人就是那称为　神的大能者。」
8.en: to whom they all listened, from the least to the greatest, saying, “This man is that great power of God.”

8.zh: 他们听从他，因他久用邪术，使他们惊奇。
8.en: They listened to him because for a long time he had amazed them with his sorceries.

8.zh: 及至他们信了腓利所传　神国的福音和耶稣基督的名，连男带女就受了洗。
8.en: But when they believed Philip preaching good news concerning God’s Kingdom and the name of Jesus Christ, they were baptized, both men and women.

8.zh: 西门自己也信了；既受了洗，就常与腓利在一处，看见他所行的神迹和大异能，就甚惊奇。
8.en: Simon himself also believed. Being baptized, he continued with Philip. Seeing signs and great miracles occurring, he was amazed.

8.zh: 使徒在耶路撒冷听见撒马利亚人领受了　神的道，就打发彼得、约翰往他们那里去。
8.en: Now when the apostles who were at Jerusalem heard that Samaria had received the word of God, they sent Peter and John to them,

8.zh: 两个人到了，就为他们祷告，要叫他们受圣灵。
8.en: who, when they had come down, prayed for them, that they might receive the Holy Spirit;

8.zh: 因为圣灵还没有降在他们一个人身上，他们只奉主耶稣的名受了洗。
8.en: for as yet he had fallen on none of them. They had only been baptized in the name of Christ Jesus.

8.zh: 于是使徒按手在他们[头]上，他们就受了圣灵。
8.en: Then they laid their hands on them, and they received the Holy Spirit.

8.zh: 西门看见使徒按手，便有圣灵赐下，就拿钱给使徒，
8.en: Now when Simon saw that the Holy Spirit was given through the laying on of the apostles’ hands, he offered them money,

8.zh: 说：「把这权柄也给我，叫我手按着谁，谁就可以受圣灵。」
8.en: saying, “Give me also this power, that whomever I lay my hands on may receive the Holy Spirit.”

8.zh: 彼得说：「你的银子和你一同灭亡吧！因你想　神的恩赐是可以用钱买的。
8.en: But Peter said to him, “May your silver perish with you, because you thought you could obtain the gift of God with money!

8.zh: 你在这道上无分无关；因为在　神面前，你的心不正。
8.en: You have neither part nor lot in this matter, for your heart isn’t right before God.

8.zh: 你当懊悔你这罪恶，祈求主，或者你心里的意念可得赦免。
8.en: Repent therefore of this, your wickedness, and ask God if perhaps the thought of your heart may be forgiven you.

8.zh: 我看出你正在苦胆之中，被罪恶捆绑。」
8.en: For I see that you are in the poison of bitterness and in the bondage of iniquity.”

8.zh: 西门说：「愿你们为我求主，叫你们所说的，没有一样临到我身上。」
8.en: Simon answered, “Pray for me to the Lord, that none of the things which you have spoken happen to me.”

8.zh: 使徒既证明主道，而且传讲，就回耶路撒冷去，一路在撒马利亚好些村庄传扬福音。
8.en: They therefore, when they had testified and spoken the word of the Lord, returned to Jerusalem, and preached the Good News to many villages of the Samaritans.

8.zh: 有主的一个使者对腓利说：「起来！向南走，往那从耶路撒冷下迦萨的路上去。」那路是旷野。
8.en: Then an angel of the Lord spoke to Philip, saying, “Arise, and go toward the south to the way that goes down from Jerusalem to Gaza. This is a desert.”

8.zh: 腓利就起身去了，不料，有一个衣索匹亚人，是个有大权的太监，在衣索匹亚女王甘大基的手下总管银库，他上耶路撒冷礼拜去了。
8.en: He arose and went; and behold, there was a man of Ethiopia, a eunuch of great authority under Candace, queen of the Ethiopians, who was over all her treasure, who had come to Jerusalem to worship.

8.zh: 现在回来，在车上坐着，念先知以赛亚的书。
8.en: He was returning and sitting in his chariot, and was reading the prophet Isaiah.

8.zh: 圣灵对腓利说：「你去！贴近那车走。」
8.en: The Spirit said to Philip, “Go near, and join yourself to this chariot.”

8.zh: 腓利就跑到太监那里，听见他念先知以赛亚的书，便问他说：「你所念的，你明白吗？」
8.en: Philip ran to him, and heard him reading Isaiah the prophet, and said, “Do you understand what you are reading?”

8.zh: 他说：「没有人指教我，怎能明白呢？」于是请腓利上车，与他同坐。
8.en: He said, “How can I, unless someone explains it to me?” He begged Philip to come up and sit with him.

8.zh: 他所念的那段经，说： 他像羊被牵到宰杀之地， 又像羊羔在剪毛的人手下无声； 他也是这样不开口。
8.en: Now the passage of the Scripture which he was reading was this, “He was led as a sheep to the slaughter. As a lamb before his shearer is silent, so he doesn’t open his mouth.

8.zh: 他卑微的时候， 人不按公义审判他； 谁能述说他的世代？ 因为他的生命从地上夺去。
8.en: In his humiliation, his judgment was taken away. Who will declare His generation? For his life is taken from the earth.”

8.zh: 太监对腓利说：「请问，先知说这话是指着谁？是指着自己呢？是指着别人呢？」
8.en: The eunuch answered Philip, “Who is the prophet talking about? About himself, or about someone else?”

8.zh: 腓利就开口从这经上起，对他传讲耶稣。
8.en: Philip opened his mouth, and beginning from this Scripture, preached to him about Jesus.

8.zh: 二人正往前走，到了有水的地方，太监说：「看哪，这里有水，我受洗有什么妨碍呢？」
8.en: As they went on the way, they came to some water; and the eunuch said, “Behold, here is water. What is keeping me from being baptized?”

8.zh: 于是吩咐车站住，腓利和太监二人同下水里去，腓利就给他施洗。
8.en: He commanded the chariot to stand still, and they both went down into the water, both Philip and the eunuch, and he baptized him.

8.zh: 从水里上来，主的灵把腓利提了去，太监也不再见他了，就欢欢喜喜地走路。
8.en: When they came up out of the water, the Spirit of the Lord caught Philip away, and the eunuch didn’t see him any more, for he went on his way rejoicing.

8.zh: 后来有人在亚锁都遇见腓利；他走遍那地方，在各城宣传福音，直到凯撒利亚。
8.en: But Philip was found at Azotus. Passing through, he preached the Good News to all the cities until he came to Caesarea.

9.zh: 扫罗仍然向主的门徒口吐威吓凶杀的话，去见大祭司，
9.en: But Saul, still breathing threats and slaughter against the disciples of the Lord, went to the high priest

9.zh: 求文书给大马士革的各会堂，若是找着信奉这道的人，无论男女，都准他捆绑带到耶路撒冷。
9.en: and asked for letters from him to the synagogues of Damascus, that if he found any who were of the Way, whether men or women, he might bring them bound to Jerusalem.

9.zh: 扫罗行路，将到大马士革，忽然从天上发光，四面照着他；
9.en: As he traveled, he got close to Damascus, and suddenly a light from the sky shone around him.

9.zh: 他就仆倒在地，听见有声音对他说：「扫罗！扫罗！你为什么逼迫我？」
9.en: He fell on the earth, and heard a voice saying to him, “Saul, Saul, why do you persecute me?”

9.zh: 他说：「主啊！你是谁？」主说：「我就是你所逼迫的耶稣。
9.en: He said, “Who are you, Lord?” The Lord said, “I am Jesus, whom you are persecuting.

9.zh: 起来！进城去，你所当做的事，必有人告诉你。」
9.en: But rise up and enter into the city, then you will be told what you must do.”

9.zh: 同行的人站在那里，说不出话来，听见声音，却看不见人。
9.en: The men who traveled with him stood speechless, hearing the sound, but seeing no one.

9.zh: 扫罗从地上起来，睁开眼睛，竟不能看见什么。有人拉他的手，领他进了大马士革；
9.en: Saul arose from the ground, and when his eyes were opened, he saw no one. They led him by the hand and brought him into Damascus.

9.zh: 三日不能看见，也不吃也不喝。
9.en: He was without sight for three days, and neither ate nor drank.

9.zh: 当下，在大马士革有一个门徒，名叫亚拿尼亚。主在异象中对他说：「亚拿尼亚。」他说：「主，我在这里。」
9.en: Now there was a certain disciple at Damascus named Ananias. The Lord said to him in a vision, “Ananias!” He said, “Behold, it’s me, Lord.”

9.zh: 主对他说：「起来！往直街去，在犹大的家里，访问一个大数人，名叫扫罗。他正祷告，
9.en: The Lord said to him, “Arise and go to the street which is called Straight, and inquire in the house of Judah for one named Saul, a man of Tarsus. For behold, he is praying,

9.zh: 又看见了一个人，名叫亚拿尼亚，进来按手在他身上，叫他能看见。」
9.en: and in a vision he has seen a man named Ananias coming in and laying his hands on him, that he might receive his sight.”

9.zh: 亚拿尼亚回答说：「主啊，我听见许多人说，这人怎样在耶路撒冷多多苦害你的圣徒，
9.en: But Ananias answered, “Lord, I have heard from many about this man, how much evil he did to your saints at Jerusalem.

9.zh: 并且他在这里有从祭司长得来的权柄捆绑一切求告你名的人。」
9.en: Here he has authority from the chief priests to bind all who call on your name.”

9.zh: 主对亚拿尼亚说：「你只管去！他是我所拣选的器皿，要在外邦人和君王，并以色列人面前宣扬我的名。
9.en: But the Lord said to him, “Go your way, for he is my chosen vessel to bear my name before the nations and kings, and the children of Israel.

9.zh: 我也要指示他，为我的名必须受许多的苦难。」
9.en: For I will show him how many things he must suffer for my name’s sake.”

9.zh: 亚拿尼亚就去了，进入那家，把手按在扫罗身上，说：「兄弟扫罗，在你来的路上向你显现的主，就是耶稣，打发我来，叫你能看见，又被圣灵充满。」
9.en: Ananias departed and entered into the house. Laying his hands on him, he said, “Brother Saul, the Lord, who appeared to you on the road by which you came, has sent me that you may receive your sight and be filled with the Holy Spirit.”

9.zh: 扫罗的眼睛上，好像有鳞立刻掉下来，他就能看见。于是起来受了洗；
9.en: Immediately something like scales fell from his eyes, and he received his sight. He arose and was baptized.

9.zh: 吃过饭就健壮了。 扫罗和大马士革的门徒同住了些日子，
9.en: He took food and was strengthened. Saul stayed several days with the disciples who were at Damascus.

9.zh: 就在各会堂里宣传耶稣，说他是　神的儿子。
9.en: Immediately in the synagogues he proclaimed the Christ, that he is the Son of God.

9.zh: 凡听见的人都惊奇，说：「在耶路撒冷残害求告这名的，不是这人吗？并且他到这里来，特要捆绑他们，带到祭司长那里。」
9.en: All who heard him were amazed, and said, “Isn’t this he who in Jerusalem made havoc of those who called on this name? And he had come here intending to bring them bound before the chief priests!”

9.zh: 但扫罗越发有能力，驳倒住大马士革的犹太人，证明耶稣是基督。
9.en: But Saul increased more in strength, and confounded the Jews who lived at Damascus, proving that this is the Christ.

9.zh: 过了好些日子，犹太人商议要杀扫罗，
9.en: When many days were fulfilled, the Jews conspired together to kill him,

9.zh: 但他们的计谋被扫罗知道了。他们又昼夜在城门守候，要杀他。
9.en: but their plot became known to Saul. They watched the gates both day and night that they might kill him,

9.zh: 他的门徒就在夜间用筐子把他从城墙上缒下去。
9.en: but his disciples took him by night and let him down through the wall, lowering him in a basket.

9.zh: 扫罗到了耶路撒冷，想与门徒结交，他们却都怕他，不信他是门徒。
9.en: When Saul had come to Jerusalem, he tried to join himself to the disciples; but they were all afraid of him, not believing that he was a disciple.

9.zh: 惟有巴拿巴接待他，领去见使徒，把他在路上怎么看见主，主怎么向他说话，他在大马士革怎么奉耶稣的名放胆传道，都述说出来。
9.en: But Barnabas took him and brought him to the apostles, and declared to them how he had seen the Lord on the way, and that he had spoken to him, and how at Damascus he had preached boldly in the name of Jesus.

9.zh: 于是扫罗在耶路撒冷和门徒出入来往，
9.en: He was with them entering into Jerusalem,

9.zh: 奉主的名放胆传道，并与说希腊话的犹太人讲论辩驳；他们却想法子要杀他。
9.en: preaching boldly in the name of the Lord Jesus. He spoke and disputed against the Hellenists, but they were seeking to kill him.

9.zh: 弟兄们知道了就送他下凯撒利亚，打发他往大数去。
9.en: When the brothers knew it, they brought him down to Caesarea and sent him off to Tarsus.

9.zh: 那时，犹太、加利利、撒马利亚各处的教会都得平安，被建立；凡事敬畏主，蒙圣灵的安慰，人数就增多了。
9.en: So the assemblies throughout all Judea, Galilee, and Samaria had peace and were built up. They were multiplied, walking in the fear of the Lord and in the comfort of the Holy Spirit.

9.zh: 彼得周流四方的时候，也到了居住吕大的圣徒那里；
9.en: As Peter went throughout all those parts, he came down also to the saints who lived at Lydda.

9.zh: 遇见一个人，名叫以尼雅，得了瘫痪，在褥子上躺卧八年。
9.en: There he found a certain man named Aeneas, who had been bedridden for eight years because he was paralyzed.

9.zh: 彼得对他说：「以尼雅，耶稣基督医好你了，起来！收拾你的褥子。」他就立刻起来了。
9.en: Peter said to him, “Aeneas, Jesus Christ heals you. Get up and make your bed!” Immediately he arose.

9.zh: 凡住吕大和沙 的人都看见了他，就归服主。
9.en: All who lived at Lydda and in Sharon saw him, and they turned to the Lord.

9.zh: 在约帕有一个女徒，名叫大比大，翻[希腊]话就是多加；她广行善事，多施周济。
9.en: Now there was at Joppa a certain disciple named Tabitha, which when translated means Dorcas. This woman was full of good works and acts of mercy which she did.

9.zh: 当时，她患病而死，有人把她洗了，停在楼上。
9.en: In those days, she became sick and died. When they had washed her, they laid her in an upper room.

9.zh: 吕大原与约帕相近；门徒听见彼得在那里，就打发两个人去见他，央求他说：「快到我们那里去，不要耽延。」
9.en: As Lydda was near Joppa, the disciples, hearing that Peter was there, sent two men to him, imploring him not to delay in coming to them.

9.zh: 彼得就起身和他们同去；到了，便有人领他上楼。众寡妇都站在彼得旁边哭，拿多加与她们同在时所做的里衣外衣给他看。
9.en: Peter got up and went with them. When he had come, they brought him into the upper room. All the widows stood by him weeping, and showing the tunics and other garments which Dorcas had made while she was with them.

9.zh: 彼得叫她们都出去，就跪下祷告，转身对着死人说：「大比大，起来！」她就睁开眼睛，见了彼得，便坐起来。
9.en: Peter sent them all out, and knelt down and prayed. Turning to the body, he said, “Tabitha, get up!” She opened her eyes, and when she saw Peter, she sat up.

9.zh: 彼得伸手扶她起来，叫众圣徒和寡妇进去，把多加活活地交给他们。
9.en: He gave her his hand and raised her up. Calling the saints and widows, he presented her alive.

9.zh: 这事传遍了约帕，就有许多人信了主。
9.en: This became known throughout all Joppa, and many believed in the Lord.

9.zh: 此后，彼得在约帕一个硝皮匠西门的家里住了多日。
9.en: He stayed many days in Joppa with a tanner named Simon.

10.zh: 在凯撒利亚有一个人，名叫哥尼流，是「意大利营」的百夫长。
10.en: Now there was a certain man in Caesarea, Cornelius by name, a centurion of what was called the Italian Regiment,

10.zh: 他是个虔诚人，他和全家都敬畏　神，多多周济百姓，常常祷告　神。
10.en: a devout man, and one who feared God with all his house, who gave gifts for the needy generously to the people, and always prayed to God.

10.zh: 有一天，约在申初，他在异象中明明看见　神的一个使者进去，到他那里，说：「哥尼流。」
10.en: At about the ninth hour of the day, he clearly saw in a vision an angel of God coming to him and saying to him, “Cornelius!”

10.zh: 哥尼流定睛看他，惊怕说：「主啊，什么事呢？」天使说：「你的祷告和你的周济达到　神面前，已蒙记念了。
10.en: He, fastening his eyes on him and being frightened, said, “What is it, Lord?” He said to him, “Your prayers and your gifts to the needy have gone up for a memorial before God.

10.zh: 现在你当打发人往约帕去，请那称呼彼得的西门来。
10.en: Now send men to Joppa, and get Simon, who is also called Peter.

10.zh: 他住在海边一个硝皮匠西门的家里，房子在海边上。」
10.en: He is staying with a tanner named Simon, whose house is by the seaside.

10.zh: 向他说话的天使去后，哥尼流叫了两个家人和常伺候他的一个虔诚兵来，
10.en: When the angel who spoke to him had departed, Cornelius called two of his household servants and a devout soldier of those who waited on him continually.

10.zh: 把这事都述说给他们听，就打发他们往约帕去。
10.en: Having explained everything to them, he sent them to Joppa.

10.zh: 第二天，他们行路将近那城。彼得约在午正，上房顶去祷告，
10.en: Now on the next day as they were on their journey and got close to the city, Peter went up on the housetop to pray at about noon.

10.zh: 觉得饿了，想要吃。那家的人正预备饭的时候，彼得魂游象外，
10.en: He became hungry and desired to eat, but while they were preparing, he fell into a trance.

10.zh: 看见天开了，有一物降下，好像一块大布，系着四角，缒在地上，
10.en: He saw heaven opened and a certain container descending to him, like a great sheet let down by four corners on the earth,

10.zh: 里面有地上各样四足的走兽和昆虫，并天上的飞鸟；
10.en: in which were all kinds of four-footed animals of the earth, wild animals, reptiles, and birds of the sky.

10.zh: 又有声音向他说：「彼得，起来，宰了吃！」
10.en: A voice came to him, “Rise, Peter, kill and eat!”

10.zh: 彼得却说：「主啊，这是不可的！凡俗物和不洁净的物，我从来没有吃过。」
10.en: But Peter said, “Not so, Lord; for I have never eaten anything that is common or unclean.”

10.zh: 第二次有声音向他说：「　神所洁净的，你不可当作俗物。」
10.en: A voice came to him again the second time, “What God has cleansed, you must not call unclean.”

10.zh: 这样一连三次，那物随即收回天上去了。
10.en: This was done three times, and immediately the thing was received up into heaven.

10.zh: 彼得心里正在猜疑之间，不知所看见的异象是什么意思。哥尼流所差来的人已经访问到西门的家，站在门外，
10.en: Now while Peter was very perplexed in himself what the vision which he had seen might mean, behold, the men who were sent by Cornelius, having made inquiry for Simon’s house, stood before the gate,

10.zh: 喊着问：「有称呼彼得的西门住在这里没有？」
10.en: and called and asked whether Simon, who was also called Peter, was lodging there.

10.zh: 彼得还思想那异象的时候，[圣]灵向他说：「有三个人来找你。
10.en: While Peter was pondering the vision, the Spirit said to him, “Behold, three men seek you.

10.zh: 起来，下去，和他们同往，不要疑惑，因为是我差他们来的。」
10.en: But arise, get down, and go with them, doubting nothing; for I have sent them.”

10.zh: 于是彼得下去见那些人，说：「我就是你们所找的人。你们来是为什么缘故？」
10.en: Peter went down to the men, and said, “Behold, I am he whom you seek. Why have you come?”

10.zh: 他们说：「百夫长哥尼流是个义人，敬畏　神，为犹太通国所称赞。他蒙一位圣天使所指示，叫他请你到他家里去，听你的话。」
10.en: They said, “Cornelius, a centurion, a righteous man and one who fears God, and well spoken of by all the nation of the Jews, was directed by a holy angel to invite you to his house, and to listen to what you say.”

10.zh: 彼得就请他们进去，住了一宿。 次日，起身和他们同去，还有约帕的几个弟兄同着他去；
10.en: So he called them in and provided a place to stay. On the next day Peter arose and went out with them, and some of the brothers from Joppa accompanied him.

10.zh: 又次日，他们进入凯撒利亚，哥尼流已经请了他的亲属密友等候他们。
10.en: On the next day they entered into Caesarea. Cornelius was waiting for them, having called together his relatives and his near friends.

10.zh: 彼得一进去，哥尼流就迎接他，俯伏在他脚前拜他。
10.en: When Peter entered, Cornelius met him, fell down at his feet, and worshiped him.

10.zh: 彼得却拉他，说：「你起来，我也是人。」
10.en: But Peter raised him up, saying, “Stand up! I myself am also a man.”

10.zh: 彼得和他说着话进去，见有好些人在那里聚集，
10.en: As he talked with him, he went in and found many gathered together.

10.zh: 就对他们说：「你们知道，犹太人和别国的人亲近来往本是不合例的，但　神已经指示我，无论什么人都不可看作俗而不洁净的。
10.en: He said to them, “You yourselves know how it is an unlawful thing for a man who is a Jew to join himself or come to one of another nation, but God has shown me that I shouldn’t call any man unholy or unclean.

10.zh: 所以我被请的时候，就不推辞而来。现在请问：你们叫我来有什么意思呢？」
10.en: Therefore I also came without complaint when I was sent for. I ask therefore, why did you send for me?”

10.zh: 哥尼流说：「前四天，这个时候，我在家中守着申初的祷告，忽然有一个人穿着光明的衣裳，站在我面前，
10.en: Cornelius said, “Four days ago, I was fasting until this hour; and at the ninth hour, I prayed in my house, and behold, a man stood before me in bright clothing

10.zh: 说：『哥尼流，你的祷告已蒙垂听，你的周济达到　神面前已蒙记念了。
10.en: and said, ‘Cornelius, your prayer is heard, and your gifts to the needy are remembered in the sight of God.

10.zh: 你当打发人往约帕去，请那称呼彼得的西门来，他住在海边一个硝皮匠西门的家里。』
10.en: Send therefore to Joppa and summon Simon, who is also called Peter. He is staying in the house of a tanner named Simon, by the seaside. When he comes, he will speak to you.’

10.zh: 所以我立时打发人去请你。你来了很好；现今我们都在　神面前，要听主所吩咐你的一切话。」
10.en: Therefore I sent to you at once, and it was good of you to come. Now therefore we are all here present in the sight of God to hear all things that have been commanded you by God.”

10.zh: 彼得就开口说：「我真看出　神是不偏待人。
10.en: Peter opened his mouth and said, “Truly I perceive that God doesn’t show favoritism;

10.zh: 原来，各国中那敬畏主、行义的人都为主所悦纳。
10.en: but in every nation he who fears him and works righteousness is acceptable to him.

10.zh: 神借着耶稣基督（他是万有的主）传和平的福音，将这道赐给以色列人。
10.en: The word which he sent to the children of Israel, preaching good news of peace by Jesus Christ—he is Lord of all—

10.zh: 这话在约翰宣传洗礼以后，从加利利起，传遍了犹太。
10.en: you yourselves know what happened, which was proclaimed throughout all Judea, beginning from Galilee, after the baptism which John preached;

10.zh: 神怎样以圣灵和能力膏拿撒勒人耶稣，这都是你们知道的。他周流四方，行善事，医好凡被魔鬼压制的人，因为　神与他同在。
10.en: how God anointed Jesus of Nazareth with the Holy Spirit and with power, who went about doing good and healing all who were oppressed by the devil, for God was with him.

10.zh: 他在犹太人之地，并耶路撒冷所行的一切事，有我们作见证。他们竟把他挂在木头上杀了。
10.en: We are witnesses of everything he did both in the country of the Jews and in Jerusalem; whom they also killed, hanging him on a tree.

10.zh: 第三日，　神叫他复活，显现出来；
10.en: God raised him up the third day and gave him to be revealed,

10.zh: 不是显现给众人看，乃是显现给　神预先所拣选为他作见证的人看，就是我们这些在他从死里复活以后和他同吃同喝的人。
10.en: not to all the people, but to witnesses who were chosen before by God, to us, who ate and drank with him after he rose from the dead.

10.zh: 他吩咐我们传道给众人，证明他是　神所立定的，要作审判活人、死人的主。
10.en: He commanded us to preach to the people and to testify that this is he who is appointed by God as the Judge of the living and the dead.

10.zh: 众先知也为他作见证说：『凡信他的人必因他的名得蒙赦罪。』」
10.en: All the prophets testify about him, that through his name everyone who believes in him will receive remission of sins.”

10.zh: 彼得还说这话的时候，圣灵降在一切听道的人身上。
10.en: While Peter was still speaking these words, the Holy Spirit fell on all those who heard the word.

10.zh: 那些奉割礼、和彼得同来的信徒，见圣灵的恩赐也浇在外邦人身上，就都希奇；
10.en: They of the circumcision who believed were amazed, as many as came with Peter, because the gift of the Holy Spirit was also poured out on the Gentiles.

10.zh: 因听见他们说方言，称赞　神为大。
10.en: For they heard them speaking in other languages and magnifying God. Then Peter answered,

10.zh: 于是彼得说：「这些人既受了圣灵，与我们一样，谁能禁止用水给他们施洗呢？」
10.en: “Can anyone forbid these people from being baptized with water? They have received the Holy Spirit just like us.”

10.zh: 就吩咐奉耶稣基督的名给他们施洗。他们又请彼得住了几天。
10.en: He commanded them to be baptized in the name of Jesus Christ. Then they asked him to stay some days.

11.zh: 使徒和在犹太的众弟兄听说外邦人也领受了　神的道。
11.en: Now the apostles and the brothers who were in Judea heard that the Gentiles had also received the word of God.

11.zh: 及至彼得上了耶路撒冷，那些奉割礼的门徒和他争辩说：
11.en: When Peter had come up to Jerusalem, those who were of the circumcision contended with him,

11.zh: 「你进入未受割礼之人的家和他们一同吃饭了。」
11.en: saying, “You went in to uncircumcised men and ate with them!”

11.zh: 彼得就开口把这事挨次给他们讲解说：
11.en: But Peter began, and explained to them in order, saying,

11.zh: 「我在约帕城里祷告的时候，魂游象外，看见异象，有一物降下，好像一块大布，系着四角，从天缒下，直来到我跟前。
11.en: “I was in the city of Joppa praying, and in a trance I saw a vision: a certain container descending, like it was a great sheet let down from heaven by four corners. It came as far as me.

11.zh: 我定睛观看，见内中有地上四足的牲畜和野兽、昆虫，并天上的飞鸟。
11.en: When I had looked intently at it, I considered, and saw the four-footed animals of the earth, wild animals, creeping things, and birds of the sky.

11.zh: 我且听见有声音向我说：『彼得，起来，宰了吃！』
11.en: I also heard a voice saying to me, ‘Rise, Peter, kill and eat!’

11.zh: 我说：『主啊，这是不可的！凡俗而不洁净的物从来没有入过我的口。』
11.en: But I said, ‘Not so, Lord, for nothing unholy or unclean has ever entered into my mouth.’

11.zh: 第二次，有声音从天上说：『　神所洁净的，你不可当作俗物。』
11.en: But a voice answered me the second time out of heaven, ‘What God has cleansed, don’t you call unclean.’

11.zh: 这样一连三次，就都收回天上去了。
11.en: This was done three times, and all were drawn up again into heaven.

11.zh: 正当那时，有三个人站在我们所住的房门前，是从凯撒利亚差来见我的。
11.en: Behold, immediately three men stood before the house where I was, having been sent from Caesarea to me.

11.zh: 圣灵吩咐我和他们同去，不要疑惑。同着我去的，还有这六位弟兄，我们都进了那人的家。
11.en: The Spirit told me to go with them without discriminating. These six brothers also accompanied me, and we entered into the man’s house.

11.zh: 那人就告诉我们，他如何看见一位天使站在他屋里，说：『你打发人往约帕去，请那称呼彼得的西门来，
11.en: He told us how he had seen the angel standing in his house and saying to him, ‘Send to Joppa and get Simon, who is called Peter,

11.zh: 他有话告诉你，可以叫你和你的全家得救。』
11.en: who will speak to you words by which you will be saved, you and all your house.’

11.zh: 我一开讲，圣灵便降在他们身上，正像当初降在我们身上一样。
11.en: As I began to speak, the Holy Spirit fell on them, even as on us at the beginning.

11.zh: 我就想起主的话说：『约翰是用水施洗，但你们要受圣灵的洗。』
11.en: I remembered the word of the Lord, how he said, ‘John indeed baptized in water, but you will be baptized in the Holy Spirit.’

11.zh: 神既然给他们恩赐，像在我们信主耶稣基督的时候给了我们一样；我是谁，能拦阻　神呢？」
11.en: If then God gave to them the same gift as us when we believed in the Lord Jesus Christ, who was I, that I could withstand God?”

11.zh: 众人听见这话，就不言语了，只归荣耀与　神，说：「这样看来，　神也赐恩给外邦人，叫他们悔改得生命了。」
11.en: When they heard these things, they held their peace and glorified God, saying, “Then God has also granted to the Gentiles repentance to life!”

11.zh: 那些因司提反的事遭患难四散的门徒直走到腓尼基和塞浦路斯，并安提阿；他们不向别人讲道，只向犹太人讲。
11.en: They therefore who were scattered abroad by the oppression that arose about Stephen traveled as far as Phoenicia, Cyprus, and Antioch, speaking the word to no one except to Jews only.

11.zh: 但内中有塞浦路斯和古利奈人，他们到了安提阿也向希腊人传讲主耶稣。
11.en: But there were some of them, men of Cyprus and Cyrene, who, when they had come to Antioch, spoke to the Hellenists, preaching the Lord Jesus.

11.zh: 主与他们同在，信而归主的人就很多了。
11.en: The hand of the Lord was with them, and a great number believed and turned to the Lord.

11.zh: 这风声传到耶路撒冷教会人的耳中，他们就打发巴拿巴出去，走到安提阿为止。
11.en: The report concerning them came to the ears of the assembly which was in Jerusalem. They sent out Barnabas to go as far as Antioch,

11.zh: 他到了那里，看见　神所赐的恩就欢喜，劝勉众人，立定心志，恒久靠主。
11.en: who, when he had come, and had seen the grace of God, was glad. He exhorted them all, that with purpose of heart they should remain near to the Lord.

11.zh: 这巴拿巴原是个好人，被圣灵充满，大有信心。于是有许多人归服了主。
11.en: For he was a good man, and full of the Holy Spirit and of faith, and many people were added to the Lord.

11.zh: 他又往大数去找扫罗，
11.en: Barnabas went out to Tarsus to look for Saul.

11.zh: 找着了，就带他到安提阿去。他们足有一年的工夫和教会一同聚集，教训了许多人。门徒称为「基督徒」是从安提阿起首。
11.en: When he had found him, he brought him to Antioch. For a whole year they were gathered together with the assembly, and taught many people. The disciples were first called Christians in Antioch.

11.zh: 当那些日子，有几位先知从耶路撒冷下到安提阿。
11.en: Now in these days, prophets came down from Jerusalem to Antioch.

11.zh: 内中有一位，名叫亚迦布，站起来，借着[圣]灵指明天下将有大饥荒。（这事到克劳第年间果然有了。）
11.en: One of them named Agabus stood up and indicated by the Spirit that there should be a great famine all over the world, which also happened in the days of Claudius.

11.zh: 于是门徒定意照各人的力量捐钱，送去供给住在犹太的弟兄。
11.en: As any of the disciples had plenty, each determined to send relief to the brothers who lived in Judea;

11.zh: 他们就这样行，把捐项托巴拿巴和扫罗送到众长老那里。
11.en: which they also did, sending it to the elders by the hands of Barnabas and Saul.

12.zh: 那时，希律王下手苦害教会中几个人，
12.en: Now about that time, King Herod stretched out his hands to oppress some of the assembly.

12.zh: 用刀杀了约翰的哥哥雅各。
12.en: He killed James, the brother of John, with the sword.

12.zh: 他见犹太人喜欢这事，又去捉拿彼得。那时正是除酵的日子。
12.en: When he saw that it pleased the Jews, he proceeded to seize Peter also. This was during the days of unleavened bread.

12.zh: 希律拿了彼得，收在监里，交付四班兵丁看守，每班四个人，意思要在逾越节后把他提出来，当着百姓[办他]。
12.en: When he had arrested him, he put him in prison and delivered him to four squads of four soldiers each to guard him, intending to bring him out to the people after the Passover.

12.zh: 于是彼得被囚在监里；教会却为他切切地祷告　神。
12.en: Peter therefore was kept in the prison, but constant prayer was made by the assembly to God for him.

12.zh: 希律将要提他出来的前一夜，彼得被两条铁链锁着，睡在两个兵丁当中；看守的人也在门外看守。
12.en: The same night when Herod was about to bring him out, Peter was sleeping between two soldiers, bound with two chains. Guards in front of the door kept the prison.

12.zh: 忽然，有主的一个使者站在旁边，屋里有光照耀，天使拍彼得的肋旁，拍醒了他，说：「快快起来！」那铁链就从他手上脱落下来。
12.en: And behold, an angel of the Lord stood by him, and a light shone in the cell. He struck Peter on the side and woke him up, saying, “Stand up quickly!” His chains fell off his hands.

12.zh: 天使对他说：「束上带子，穿上鞋。」他就那样做。天使又说：「披上外衣，跟着我来。」
12.en: The angel said to him, “Get dressed and put on your sandals.” He did so. He said to him, “Put on your cloak and follow me.”

12.zh: 彼得就出来跟着他，不知道天使所做是真的，只当见了异象。
12.en: And he went out and followed him. He didn’t know that what was being done by the angel was real, but thought he saw a vision.

12.zh: 过了第一层第二层监牢，就来到临街的铁门，那门自己开了。他们出来，走过一条街，天使便离开他去了。
12.en: When they were past the first and the second guard, they came to the iron gate that leads into the city, which opened to them by itself. They went out and went down one street, and immediately the angel departed from him.

12.zh: 彼得醒悟过来，说：「我现在真知道主差遣他的使者，救我脱离希律的手和犹太百姓一切所盼望的。」
12.en: When Peter had come to himself, he said, “Now I truly know that the Lord has sent out his angel and delivered me out of the hand of Herod, and from everything the Jewish people were expecting.”

12.zh: 想了一想，就往那称呼马可的约翰、他母亲马利亚家去，在那里有好些人聚集祷告。
12.en: Thinking about that, he came to the house of Mary, the mother of John who was called Mark, where many were gathered together and were praying.

12.zh: 彼得敲外门，有一个使女，名叫罗大，出来探听，
12.en: When Peter knocked at the door of the gate, a servant girl named Rhoda came to answer.

12.zh: 听得是彼得的声音，就欢喜的顾不得开门，跑进去告诉众人说：「彼得站在门外。」
12.en: When she recognized Peter’s voice, she didn’t open the gate for joy, but ran in and reported that Peter was standing in front of the gate.

12.zh: 他们说：「你是疯了！」使女极力地说：「真是他！」他们说：「必是他的天使！」
12.en: They said to her, “You are crazy!” But she insisted that it was so. They said, “It is his angel.”

12.zh: 彼得不住地敲门。他们开了门，看见他，就甚惊奇。
12.en: But Peter continued knocking. When they had opened, they saw him and were amazed.

12.zh: 彼得摆手，不要他们作声，就告诉他们主怎样领他出监；又说：「你们把这事告诉雅各和众弟兄。」于是出去，往别处去了。
12.en: But he, beckoning to them with his hand to be silent, declared to them how the Lord had brought him out of the prison. He said, “Tell these things to James and to the brothers.” Then he departed and went to another place.

12.zh: 到了天亮，兵丁扰乱得很，不知道彼得往哪里去了。
12.en: Now as soon as it was day, there was no small stir among the soldiers about what had become of Peter.

12.zh: 希律找他，找不着，就审问看守的人，吩咐把他们拉去杀了。后来希律离开犹太，下凯撒利亚去，住在那里。
12.en: When Herod had sought for him and didn’t find him, he examined the guards, then commanded that they should be put to death. He went down from Judea to Caesarea, and stayed there.

12.zh: 希律恼怒泰尔、西顿的人。他们那一带地方是从王的地土得粮，因此就托了王的内侍臣伯拉斯都的情，一心来求和。
12.en: Now Herod was very angry with the people of Tyre and Sidon. They came with one accord to him and, having made Blastus, the king’s personal aide, their friend, they asked for peace, because their country depended on the king’s country for food.

12.zh: 希律在所定的日子，穿上朝服，坐在位上，对他们讲论一番。
12.en: On an appointed day, Herod dressed himself in royal clothing, sat on the throne, and gave a speech to them.

12.zh: 百姓喊着说：「这是神的声音，不是人的声音。」
12.en: The people shouted, “The voice of a god, and not of a man!”

12.zh: 希律不归荣耀给　神，所以主的使者立刻罚他，他被虫所咬，气就绝了。
12.en: Immediately an angel of the Lord struck him, because he didn’t give God the glory. Then he was eaten by worms and died.

12.zh: 神的道日见兴旺，越发广传。
12.en: But the word of God grew and multiplied.

12.zh: 巴拿巴和扫罗办完了他们供给的事，就从耶路撒冷回来，带着称呼马可的约翰同去。
12.en: Barnabas and Saul returned to Jerusalem when they had fulfilled their service, also taking with them John who was called Mark.

13.zh: 在安提阿的教会中，有几位先知和教师，就是巴拿巴和称呼尼结的西面、古利奈人路求，与分封之王希律同养的马念，并扫罗。
13.en: Now in the assembly that was at Antioch there were some prophets and teachers: Barnabas, Simeon who was called Niger, Lucius of Cyrene, Manaen the foster brother of Herod the tetrarch, and Saul.

13.zh: 他们事奉主、禁食的时候，圣灵说：「要为我分派巴拿巴和扫罗，去做我召他们所做的工。」
13.en: As they served the Lord and fasted, the Holy Spirit said, “Separate Barnabas and Saul for me, for the work to which I have called them.”

13.zh: 于是禁食祷告，按手在他们[头]上，就打发他们去了。
13.en: Then, when they had fasted and prayed and laid their hands on them, they sent them away.

13.zh: 他们既被圣灵差遣，就下到西流基，从那里坐船往塞浦路斯去。
13.en: So, being sent out by the Holy Spirit, they went down to Seleucia. From there they sailed to Cyprus.

13.zh: 到了撒拉米，就在犹太人各会堂里传讲　神的道，也有约翰作他们的帮手。
13.en: When they were at Salamis, they proclaimed God’s word in the Jewish synagogues. They also had John as their attendant.

13.zh: 经过全岛，直到帕弗，在那里遇见一个有法术、假充先知的犹太人，名叫巴·耶稣。
13.en: When they had gone through the island to Paphos, they found a certain sorcerer, a false prophet, a Jew whose name was Bar Jesus,

13.zh: 这人常和方伯士求·保罗同在。士求·保罗是个通达人，他请了巴拿巴和扫罗来，要听　神的道。
13.en: who was with the proconsul, Sergius Paulus, a man of understanding. This man summoned Barnabas and Saul, and sought to hear the word of God.

13.zh: 只是那行法术的以吕马（这名翻出来就是行法术的意思）敌挡使徒，要叫方伯不信真道。
13.en: But Elymas the sorcerer (for so is his name by interpretation) withstood them, seeking to turn the proconsul away from the faith.

13.zh: 扫罗又名保罗，被圣灵充满，定睛看他，
13.en: But Saul, who is also called Paul, filled with the Holy Spirit, fastened his eyes on him

13.zh: 说：「你这充满各样诡诈奸恶，魔鬼的儿子，众善的仇敌，你混乱主的正道还不止住吗？
13.en: and said, “You son of the devil, full of all deceit and all cunning, you enemy of all righteousness, will you not cease to pervert the right ways of the Lord?

13.zh: 现在主的手加在你身上，你要瞎眼，暂且不见日光。」他的眼睛立刻昏蒙黑暗，四下里求人拉着手领他。
13.en: Now, behold, the hand of the Lord is on you, and you will be blind, not seeing the sun for a season!” Immediately a mist and darkness fell on him. He went around seeking someone to lead him by the hand.

13.zh: 方伯看见所做的事，很希奇主的道，就信了。
13.en: Then the proconsul, when he saw what was done, believed, being astonished at the teaching of the Lord.

13.zh: 保罗和他的同人从帕弗开船，来到旁非利亚的别加，约翰就离开他们，回耶路撒冷去。
13.en: Now Paul and his company set sail from Paphos and came to Perga in Pamphylia. John departed from them and returned to Jerusalem.

13.zh: 他们离了别加往前行，来到彼西底的安提阿，在安息日进会堂坐下。
13.en: But they, passing on from Perga, came to Antioch of Pisidia. They went into the synagogue on the Sabbath day and sat down.

13.zh: 读完了律法和先知[的书]，管会堂的叫人过去，对他们说：「二位兄台，若有什么劝勉众人的话，请说。」
13.en: After the reading of the law and the prophets, the rulers of the synagogue sent to them, saying, “Brothers, if you have any word of exhortation for the people, speak.”

13.zh: 保罗就站起来，举手，说：「以色列人和一切敬畏　神的人，请听。
13.en: Paul stood up, and gesturing with his hand said, “Men of Israel, and you who fear God, listen.

13.zh: 这以色列民的　神拣选了我们的祖宗，当民寄居埃及的时候抬举他们，用大能的手领他们出来；
13.en: The God of this people chose our fathers, and exalted the people when they stayed as aliens in the land of Egypt, and with an uplifted arm, he led them out of it.

13.zh: 又在旷野容忍他们，约有四十年。
13.en: For a period of about forty years he put up with them in the wilderness.

13.zh: 既灭了迦南地七族的人，就把那地分给他们为业；
13.en: When he had destroyed seven nations in the land of Canaan, he gave them their land for an inheritance for about four hundred fifty years.

13.zh: 此后给他们设立士师，约有四百五十年，直到先知撒母耳的时候。
13.en: After these things, he gave them judges until Samuel the prophet.

13.zh: 后来他们求一个王，　神就将便雅悯支派中基士的儿子扫罗，给他们作王四十年。
13.en: Afterward they asked for a king, and God gave to them Saul the son of Kish, a man of the tribe of Benjamin, for forty years.

13.zh: 既废了扫罗，就选立大卫作他们的王，又为他作见证说：『我寻得耶西的儿子大卫，他是合我心意的人，凡事要遵行我的旨意。』
13.en: When he had removed him, he raised up David to be their king, to whom he also testified, ‘I have found David the son of Jesse, a man after my heart, who will do all my will.’

13.zh: 从这人的后裔中，　神已经照着所应许的，为以色列人立了一位救主，就是耶稣。
13.en: From this man’s offspring, God has brought salvation to Israel according to his promise,

13.zh: 在他没有出来以先，约翰向以色列众民宣讲悔改的洗礼。
13.en: before his coming, when John had first preached the baptism of repentance to Israel.

13.zh: 约翰将行尽他的程途说：『你们以为我是谁？我不是[基督]；只是有一位在我以后来的，我解他脚上的鞋带也是不配的。』
13.en: As John was fulfilling his course, he said, ‘What do you suppose that I am? I am not he. But behold, one comes after me, the sandals of whose feet I am not worthy to untie.’

13.zh: 「弟兄们，亚伯拉罕的子孙和你们中间敬畏　神的人哪，这救世的道是传给我们的。
13.en: “Brothers, children of the stock of Abraham, and those among you who fear God, the word of this salvation is sent out to you.

13.zh: 耶路撒冷居住的人和他们的官长，因为不认识基督，也不明白每安息日所读众先知的书，就把基督定了死罪，正应了先知的预言；
13.en: For those who dwell in Jerusalem, and their rulers, because they didn’t know him, nor the voices of the prophets which are read every Sabbath, fulfilled them by condemning him.

13.zh: 虽然查不出他有当死的罪来，还是求彼拉多杀他；
13.en: Though they found no cause for death, they still asked Pilate to have him killed.

13.zh: 既成就了[经上]指着他所记的一切话，就把他从木头上取下来，放在坟墓里。
13.en: When they had fulfilled all things that were written about him, they took him down from the tree and laid him in a tomb.

13.zh: 神却叫他从死里复活。
13.en: But God raised him from the dead,

13.zh: 那从加利利同他上耶路撒冷的人多日看见他，这些人如今在民间是他的见证。
13.en: and he was seen for many days by those who came up with him from Galilee to Jerusalem, who are his witnesses to the people.

13.zh: 我们也报好信息给你们，就是那应许祖宗的话，
13.en: We bring you good news of the promise made to the fathers,

13.zh: 神已经向我们这作儿女的应验，叫耶稣复活了。正如诗篇第二篇上记着说： 你是我的儿子， 我今日生你。
13.en: that God has fulfilled this to us, their children, in that he raised up Jesus. As it is also written in the second psalm, ‘You are my Son. Today I have become your father.’

13.zh: 论到　神叫他从死里复活，不再归于朽坏，就这样说： 我必将[所应许]大卫那圣洁、 可靠的[恩典]赐给你们。
13.en: “Concerning that he raised him up from the dead, now no more to return to corruption, he has spoken thus: ‘I will give you the holy and sure blessings of David.’

13.zh: 又有一篇上说： 你必不叫你的圣者见朽坏。
13.en: Therefore he says also in another psalm, ‘You will not allow your Holy One to see decay.’

13.zh: 「大卫在世的时候遵行了　神的旨意，就睡了，归到他祖宗那里，已见朽坏；
13.en: For David, after he had in his own generation served the counsel of God, fell asleep, was laid with his fathers, and saw decay.

13.zh: 惟独　神所复活的，他并未见朽坏。
13.en: But he whom God raised up saw no decay.

13.zh: 所以，弟兄们，你们当晓得：赦罪的道是由这人传给你们的。
13.en: Be it known to you therefore, brothers, that through this man is proclaimed to you remission of sins;

13.zh: 你们靠摩西的律法，在一切不得称义的事上信靠这人，就都得称义了。
13.en: and by him everyone who believes is justified from all things, from which you could not be justified by the law of Moses.

13.zh: 所以，你们务要小心，免得先知书上所说的临到你们。
13.en: Beware therefore, lest that come on you which is spoken in the prophets:

13.zh: 主[说]： 你们这轻慢的人要观看，要惊奇，要灭亡； 因为在你们的时候，我行一件事， 虽有人告诉你们， 你们总是不信。」
