13.en: ‘Behold, you scoffers! Wonder and perish, for I work a work in your days, a work which you will in no way believe, if one declares it to you.’”

13.zh: 他们出会堂的时候，众人请他们到下安息日再讲这话给他们听。
13.en: So when the Jews went out of the synagogue, the Gentiles begged that these words might be preached to them the next Sabbath.

13.zh: 散会以后，犹太人和敬虔进犹太教的人多有跟从保罗、巴拿巴的。二人对他们讲道，劝他们务要恒久在　神的恩中。
13.en: Now when the synagogue broke up, many of the Jews and of the devout proselytes followed Paul and Barnabas; who, speaking to them, urged them to continue in the grace of God.

13.zh: 到下安息日，合城的人几乎都来聚集，要听　神的道。
13.en: The next Sabbath, almost the whole city was gathered together to hear the word of God.

13.zh: 但犹太人看见人这样多，就满心嫉妒，硬驳保罗所说的话，并且毁谤。
13.en: But when the Jews saw the multitudes, they were filled with jealousy, and contradicted the things which were spoken by Paul, and blasphemed.

13.zh: 保罗和巴拿巴放胆说：「　神的道先讲给你们原是应当的；只因你们弃绝这道，断定自己不配得永生，我们就转向外邦人去。
13.en: Paul and Barnabas spoke out boldly, and said, “It was necessary that God’s word should be spoken to you first. Since indeed you thrust it from yourselves, and judge yourselves unworthy of eternal life, behold, we turn to the Gentiles.

13.zh: 因为主曾这样吩咐我们说： 我已经立你作外邦人的光， 叫你施行救恩，直到地极。」
13.en: For so has the Lord commanded us, saying, ‘I have set you as a light for the Gentiles, that you should bring salvation to the uttermost parts of the earth.’”

13.zh: 外邦人听见这话，就欢喜了，赞美　神的道；凡预定得永生的人都信了。
13.en: As the Gentiles heard this, they were glad and glorified the word of God. As many as were appointed to eternal life believed.

13.zh: 于是主的道传遍了那一带地方。
13.en: The Lord’s word was spread abroad throughout all the region.

13.zh: 但犹太人挑唆虔敬、尊贵的妇女和城内有名望的人，逼迫保罗、巴拿巴，将他们赶出境外。
13.en: But the Jews stirred up the devout and prominent women and the chief men of the city, and stirred up a persecution against Paul and Barnabas, and threw them out of their borders.

13.zh: 二人对着众人跺下脚上的尘土，就往以哥念去了。
13.en: But they shook off the dust of their feet against them, and came to Iconium.

13.zh: 门徒满心喜乐，又被圣灵充满。
13.en: The disciples were filled with joy and with the Holy Spirit.

14.zh: 二人在以哥念同进犹太人的会堂，在那里讲的，叫犹太人和希腊人信的很多。
14.en: In Iconium, they entered together into the synagogue of the Jews, and so spoke that a great multitude both of Jews and of Greeks believed.

14.zh: 但那不顺从的犹太人耸动外邦人，叫他们心里恼恨弟兄。
14.en: But the disbelieving Jews stirred up and embittered the souls of the Gentiles against the brothers.

14.zh: 二人在那里住了多日，倚靠主放胆讲道，主借他们的手施行神迹奇事，证明他的恩道。
14.en: Therefore they stayed there a long time, speaking boldly in the Lord, who testified to the word of his grace, granting signs and wonders to be done by their hands.

14.zh: 城里的众人就分了党，有附从犹太人的，有附从使徒的。
14.en: But the multitude of the city was divided. Part sided with the Jews and part with the apostles.

14.zh: 那时，外邦人和犹太人，并他们的官长，一齐拥上来，要凌辱使徒，用石头打他们。
14.en: When some of both the Gentiles and the Jews, with their rulers, made a violent attempt to mistreat and stone them,

14.zh: 使徒知道了，就逃往吕高尼的路司得、特庇两个城和周围地方去，
14.en: they became aware of it and fled to the cities of Lycaonia, Lystra, Derbe, and the surrounding region.

14.zh: 在那里传福音。
14.en: There they preached the Good News.

14.zh: 路司得城里坐着一个两脚无力的人，生来是瘸腿的，从来没有走过。
14.en: At Lystra a certain man sat, impotent in his feet, a cripple from his mother’s womb, who never had walked.

14.zh: 他听保罗讲道，保罗定睛看他，见他有信心，可得痊愈，
14.en: He was listening to Paul speaking, who, fastening eyes on him and seeing that he had faith to be made whole,

14.zh: 就大声说：「你起来，两脚站直！」那人就跳起来，而且行走。
14.en: said with a loud voice, “Stand upright on your feet!” He leaped up and walked.

14.zh: 众人看见保罗所做的事，就用吕高尼的话大声说：「有神借着人形降临在我们中间了。」
14.en: When the multitude saw what Paul had done, they lifted up their voice, saying in the language of Lycaonia, “The gods have come down to us in the likeness of men!”

14.zh: 于是称巴拿巴为宙斯，称保罗为希耳米，因为他说话领首。
14.en: They called Barnabas “Jupiter”, and Paul “Mercury”, because he was the chief speaker.

14.zh: 有城外宙斯[庙]的祭司牵着牛，拿着花圈，来到门前，要同众人[向使徒]献祭。
14.en: The priest of Jupiter, whose temple was in front of their city, brought oxen and garlands to the gates, and would have made a sacrifice along with the multitudes.

14.zh: 巴拿巴、保罗二使徒听见，就撕开衣裳，跳进众人中间，喊着说：
14.en: But when the apostles, Barnabas and Paul, heard of it, they tore their clothes and sprang into the multitude, crying out,

14.zh: 「诸君，为什么做这事呢？我们也是人，性情和你们一样。我们传福音给你们，是叫你们离弃这些虚妄，归向那创造天、地、海，和其中万物的永生　神。
14.en: “Men, why are you doing these things? We also are men of the same nature as you, and bring you good news, that you should turn from these vain things to the living God, who made the sky, the earth, the sea, and all that is in them;

14.zh: 他在从前的世代，任凭万国各行其道；
14.en: who in the generations gone by allowed all the nations to walk in their own ways.

14.zh: 然而为自己未尝不显出证据来，就如常施恩惠，从天降雨，赏赐丰年，叫你们饮食饱足，满心喜乐。」
14.en: Yet he didn’t leave himself without witness, in that he did good and gave you rains from the sky and fruitful seasons, filling our hearts with food and gladness.”

14.zh: 二人说了这些话，仅仅地拦住众人不献祭与他们。
14.en: Even saying these things, they hardly stopped the multitudes from making a sacrifice to them.

14.zh: 但有些犹太人从安提阿和以哥念来，挑唆众人，就用石头打保罗，以为他是死了，便拖到城外。
14.en: But some Jews from Antioch and Iconium came there, and having persuaded the multitudes, they stoned Paul and dragged him out of the city, supposing that he was dead.

14.zh: 门徒正围着他，他就起来，走进城去。 第二天，同巴拿巴往特庇去，
14.en: But as the disciples stood around him, he rose up, and entered into the city. On the next day he went out with Barnabas to Derbe.

14.zh: 对那城里[的人]传了福音，使好些人作门徒，就回路司得、以哥念、安提阿去，
14.en: When they had preached the Good News to that city and had made many disciples, they returned to Lystra, Iconium, and Antioch,

14.zh: 坚固门徒的心，劝他们恒守所信的道；又说：「我们进入　神的国，必须经历许多艰难。」
14.en: strengthening the souls of the disciples, exhorting them to continue in the faith, and that through many afflictions we must enter into God’s Kingdom.

14.zh: 二人在各教会中选立了长老，又禁食祷告，就把他们交托所信的主。
14.en: When they had appointed elders for them in every assembly, and had prayed with fasting, they commended them to the Lord on whom they had believed.

14.zh: 二人经过彼西底，来到旁非利亚。
14.en: They passed through Pisidia and came to Pamphylia.

14.zh: 在别加讲了道，就下亚大利去，
14.en: When they had spoken the word in Perga, they went down to Attalia.

14.zh: 从那里坐船，往安提阿去。当初，他们被众人所托、蒙　神之恩、要办现在所做之工，就是在这地方。
14.en: From there they sailed to Antioch, from where they had been committed to the grace of God for the work which they had fulfilled.

14.zh: 到了那里，聚集了会众，就述说　神借他们所行的一切事，并　神怎样为外邦人开了信道的门。
14.en: When they had arrived and had gathered the assembly together, they reported all the things that God had done with them, and that he had opened a door of faith to the nations.

14.zh: 二人就在那里同门徒住了多日。
14.en: They stayed there with the disciples for a long time.

15.zh: 有几个人从犹太下来，教训弟兄们说：「你们若不按摩西的规条受割礼，不能得救。」
15.en: Some men came down from Judea and taught the brothers, “Unless you are circumcised after the custom of Moses, you can’t be saved.”

15.zh: 保罗、巴拿巴与他们大大地纷争辩论；[众门徒]就定规，叫保罗、巴拿巴和本会中几个人，为所辩论的，上耶路撒冷去见使徒和长老。
15.en: Therefore when Paul and Barnabas had no small discord and discussion with them, they appointed Paul, Barnabas, and some others of them to go up to Jerusalem to the apostles and elders about this question.

15.zh: 于是教会送他们起行。他们经过腓尼基、撒马利亚，随处传说外邦人归主的事，叫众弟兄都甚欢喜。
15.en: They, being sent on their way by the assembly, passed through both Phoenicia and Samaria, declaring the conversion of the Gentiles. They caused great joy to all the brothers.

15.zh: 到了耶路撒冷，教会和使徒并长老都接待他们，他们就述说　神同他们所行的一切事。
15.en: When they had come to Jerusalem, they were received by the assembly and the apostles and the elders, and they reported everything that God had done with them.

15.zh: 惟有几个信徒是法利赛教门的人，起来说：「必须给外邦人行割礼，吩咐他们遵守摩西的律法。」
15.en: But some of the sect of the Pharisees who believed rose up, saying, “It is necessary to circumcise them, and to command them to keep the law of Moses.”

15.zh: 使徒和长老聚会商议这事；
15.en: The apostles and the elders were gathered together to see about this matter.

15.zh: 辩论已经多了，彼得就起来，说：「诸位弟兄，你们知道　神早已在你们中间拣选了我，叫外邦人从我口中得听福音之道，而且相信。
15.en: When there had been much discussion, Peter rose up and said to them, “Brothers, you know that a good while ago God made a choice among you that by my mouth the nations should hear the word of the Good News and believe.

15.zh: 知道人心的　神也为他们作了见证，赐圣灵给他们，正如给我们一样；
15.en: God, who knows the heart, testified about them, giving them the Holy Spirit, just like he did to us.

15.zh: 又借着信洁净了他们的心，并不分他们我们。
15.en: He made no distinction between us and them, cleansing their hearts by faith.

15.zh: 现在为什么试探　神，要把我们祖宗和我们所不能负的轭放在门徒的颈项上呢？
15.en: Now therefore why do you tempt God, that you should put a yoke on the neck of the disciples which neither our fathers nor we were able to bear?

15.zh: 我们得救乃是因主耶稣的恩，和他们一样，这是我们所信的。」
15.en: But we believe that we are saved through the grace of the Lord Jesus, just as they are.”

15.zh: 众人都默默无声，听巴拿巴和保罗述说　神借他们在外邦人中所行的神迹奇事。
15.en: All the multitude kept silence, and they listened to Barnabas and Paul reporting what signs and wonders God had done among the nations through them.

15.zh: 他们住了声，雅各就说：「诸位弟兄，请听我的话。
15.en: After they were silent, James answered, “Brothers, listen to me.

15.zh: 方才西门述说　神当初怎样眷顾外邦人，从他们中间选取百姓归于自己的名下；
15.en: Simeon has reported how God first visited the nations to take out of them a people for his name.

15.zh: 众先知的话也与这意思相合。
15.en: This agrees with the words of the prophets. As it is written,

15.zh: 正如[经上]所写的： 此后，我要回来， 重新修造大卫倒塌的帐幕， 把那破坏的重新修造建立起来，
15.en: ‘After these things I will return. I will again build the tabernacle of David, which has fallen. I will again build its ruins. I will set it up

15.zh: 叫余剩的人， 就是凡称为我名下的外邦人， 都寻求主。
15.en: that the rest of men may seek after the Lord: all the Gentiles who are called by my name, says the Lord, who does all these things.’

15.zh: 这话是从创世以来显明这事的主说的。
15.en: “All of God’s works are known to him from eternity.

15.zh: 「所以据我的意见，不可难为那归服　神的外邦人；
15.en: Therefore my judgment is that we don’t trouble those from among the Gentiles who turn to God,

15.zh: 只要写信，吩咐他们禁戒偶像的污秽和奸淫，并勒死的牲畜和血。
15.en: but that we write to them that they abstain from the pollution of idols, from sexual immorality, from what is strangled, and from blood.

15.zh: 因为从古以来，摩西[的书]在各城有人传讲，每逢安息日，在会堂里诵读。」
15.en: For Moses from generations of old has in every city those who preach him, being read in the synagogues every Sabbath.”

15.zh: 那时，使徒和长老并全教会定意从他们中间拣选人，差他们和保罗、巴拿巴同往安提阿去；[所拣选的]就是称呼巴撒巴的犹大和西拉。这两个人在弟兄中是作首领的。
15.en: Then it seemed good to the apostles and the elders, with the whole assembly, to choose men out of their company, and send them to Antioch with Paul and Barnabas: Judas called Barsabbas, and Silas, chief men among the brothers.

15.zh: 于是写信交付他们，内中说：「使徒和作长老的弟兄们问安提阿、叙利亚、基利家外邦众弟兄的安。
15.en: They wrote these things by their hand: “The apostles, the elders, and the brothers, to the brothers who are of the Gentiles in Antioch, Syria, and Cilicia: greetings.

15.zh: 我们听说，有几个人从我们这里出去，用言语搅扰你们，惑乱你们的心。其实我们并没有吩咐他们。
15.en: Because we have heard that some who went out from us have troubled you with words, unsettling your souls, saying, ‘You must be circumcised and keep the law,’ to whom we gave no commandment;

15.zh: 所以，我们同心定意，拣选几个人，差他们同我们所亲爱的巴拿巴和保罗往你们那里去。
15.en: it seemed good to us, having come to one accord, to choose out men and send them to you with our beloved Barnabas and Paul,

15.zh: 这二人是为我主耶稣基督的名不顾性命的。
15.en: men who have risked their lives for the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.

15.zh: 我们就差了犹大和西拉，他们也要亲口诉说这些事。
15.en: We have sent therefore Judas and Silas, who themselves will also tell you the same things by word of mouth.

15.zh: 因为圣灵和我们定意不将别的重担放在你们身上，惟有几件事是不可少的，
15.en: For it seemed good to the Holy Spirit, and to us, to lay no greater burden on you than these necessary things:

15.zh: 就是禁戒祭偶像的物和血，并勒死的牲畜和奸淫。这几件你们若能自己禁戒不犯就好了。愿你们平安！」
15.en: that you abstain from things sacrificed to idols, from blood, from things strangled, and from sexual immorality, from which if you keep yourselves, it will be well with you. Farewell.”

15.zh: 他们既奉了差遣，就下安提阿去，聚集众人，交付书信。
15.en: So, when they were sent off, they came to Antioch. Having gathered the multitude together, they delivered the letter.

15.zh: 众人念了，因为信上安慰的话就欢喜了。
15.en: When they had read it, they rejoiced over the encouragement.

15.zh: 犹大和西拉也是先知，就用许多话劝勉弟兄，坚固他们。
15.en: Judas and Silas, also being prophets themselves, encouraged the brothers with many words and strengthened them.

15.zh: 住了些日子，弟兄们打发他们平平安安地回到差遣他们的人那里去。
15.en: After they had spent some time there, they were dismissed in peace from the brothers to the apostles.

15.zh: 但保罗和巴拿巴仍住在安提阿，和许多别人一同教训人，传主的道。
15.en: But Paul and Barnabas stayed in Antioch, teaching and preaching the word of the Lord, with many others also.

15.zh: 过了些日子，保罗对巴拿巴说：「我们可以回到从前宣传主道的各城，看望弟兄们景况如何。」
15.en: After some days Paul said to Barnabas, “Let’s return now and visit our brothers in every city in which we proclaimed the word of the Lord, to see how they are doing.”

15.zh: 巴拿巴有意要带称呼马可的约翰同去；
15.en: Barnabas planned to take John, who was called Mark, with them also.

15.zh: 但保罗因为马可从前在旁非利亚离开他们，不和他们同去做工，就以为不可带他去。
15.en: But Paul didn’t think that it was a good idea to take with them someone who had withdrawn from them in Pamphylia, and didn’t go with them to do the work.

15.zh: 于是二人起了争论，甚至彼此分开。巴拿巴带着马可，坐船往塞浦路斯去；
15.en: Then the contention grew so sharp that they separated from each other. Barnabas took Mark with him and sailed away to Cyprus,

15.zh: 保罗拣选了西拉，也出去，蒙弟兄们把他交于主的恩中。
15.en: but Paul chose Silas and went out, being commended by the brothers to the grace of God.

15.zh: 他就走遍叙利亚、基利家，坚固众教会。
15.en: He went through Syria and Cilicia, strengthening the assemblies.

16.zh: 保罗来到特庇，又到路司得。在那里有一个门徒，名叫提摩太，是信主之犹太妇人的儿子，他父亲却是希腊人。
16.en: He came to Derbe and Lystra; and behold, a certain disciple was there, named Timothy, the son of a Jewess who believed, but his father was a Greek.

16.zh: 路司得和以哥念的弟兄都称赞他。
16.en: The brothers who were at Lystra and Iconium gave a good testimony about him.

16.zh: 保罗要带他同去，只因那些地方的犹太人都知道他父亲是希腊人，就给他行了割礼。
16.en: Paul wanted to have him go out with him, and he took and circumcised him because of the Jews who were in those parts, for they all knew that his father was a Greek.

16.zh: 他们经过各城，把耶路撒冷使徒和长老所定的条规交给门徒遵守。
16.en: As they went on their way through the cities, they delivered the decrees to them to keep which had been ordained by the apostles and elders who were at Jerusalem.

16.zh: 于是众教会信心越发坚固，人数天天加增。
16.en: So the assemblies were strengthened in the faith, and increased in number daily.

16.zh: 圣灵既然禁止他们在亚细亚讲道，他们就经过弗吕家、加拉太一带地方。
16.en: When they had gone through the region of Phrygia and Galatia, they were forbidden by the Holy Spirit to speak the word in Asia.

16.zh: 到了每西亚的边界，他们想要往庇推尼去，耶稣的灵却不许。
16.en: When they had come opposite Mysia, they tried to go into Bithynia, but the Spirit didn’t allow them.

16.zh: 他们就越过每西亚，下到特罗亚去。
16.en: Passing by Mysia, they came down to Troas.

16.zh: 在夜间有异象现与保罗。有一个马其顿人站着求他说：「请你过到马其顿来帮助我们。」
16.en: A vision appeared to Paul in the night. There was a man of Macedonia standing, begging him and saying, “Come over into Macedonia and help us.”

16.zh: 保罗既看见这异象，我们随即想要往马其顿去，以为　神召我们传福音给那里的人听。
16.en: When he had seen the vision, immediately we sought to go out to Macedonia, concluding that the Lord had called us to preach the Good News to them.

16.zh: 于是从特罗亚开船，一直行到撒摩特喇，第二天到了尼亚坡里。
16.en: Setting sail therefore from Troas, we made a straight course to Samothrace, and the day following to Neapolis;

16.zh: 从那里来到腓立比，就是马其顿这一方的头一个城，也是[罗马]的驻防城。我们在这城里住了几天。
16.en: and from there to Philippi, which is a city of Macedonia, the foremost of the district, a Roman colony. We were staying some days in this city.

16.zh: 当安息日，我们出城门，到了河边，知道那里有一个祷告的地方，我们就坐下对那聚会的妇女讲道。
16.en: On the Sabbath day we went outside of the city by a riverside, where we supposed there was a place of prayer, and we sat down and spoke to the women who had come together.

16.zh: 有一个卖紫色布疋的妇人，名叫吕底亚，是推雅推喇城的人，素来敬拜　神。她听见了，主就开导她的心，叫她留心听保罗所讲的话。
16.en: A certain woman named Lydia, a seller of purple, of the city of Thyatira, one who worshiped God, heard us. The Lord opened her heart to listen to the things which were spoken by Paul.

16.zh: 她和她一家既领了洗，便求我们说：「你们若以为我是真信主的，请到我家里来住」；于是强留我们。
16.en: When she and her household were baptized, she begged us, saying, “If you have judged me to be faithful to the Lord, come into my house and stay.” So she persuaded us.

16.zh: 后来，我们往那祷告的地方去。有一个使女迎着面来，她被巫鬼所附，用法术，叫她主人们大得财利。
16.en: As we were going to prayer, a certain girl having a spirit of divination met us, who brought her masters much gain by fortune telling.

16.zh: 她跟随保罗和我们，喊着说：「这些人是至高　神的仆人，对你们传说救人的道。」
16.en: Following Paul and us, she cried out, “These men are servants of the Most High God, who proclaim to us a way of salvation!”

16.zh: 她一连多日这样喊叫，保罗就心中厌烦，转身对那鬼说：「我奉耶稣基督的名，吩咐你从她身上出来！」那鬼当时就出来了。
16.en: She was doing this for many days. But Paul, becoming greatly annoyed, turned and said to the spirit, “I command you in the name of Jesus Christ to come out of her!” It came out that very hour.

16.zh: 使女的主人们见得利的指望没有了，便揪住保罗和西拉，拉他们到市上去见首领；
16.en: But when her masters saw that the hope of their gain was gone, they seized Paul and Silas and dragged them into the marketplace before the rulers.

16.zh: 又带到官长面前说：「这些人原是犹太人，竟骚扰我们的城，
16.en: When they had brought them to the magistrates, they said, “These men, being Jews, are agitating our city

16.zh: 传我们罗马人所不可受不可行的规矩。」
16.en: and advocate customs which it is not lawful for us to accept or to observe, being Romans.”

16.zh: 众人就一同起来攻击他们。官长吩咐剥了他们的衣裳，用棍打；
16.en: The multitude rose up together against them and the magistrates tore their clothes from them, then commanded them to be beaten with rods.

16.zh: 打了许多棍，便将他们下在监里，嘱咐禁卒严紧看守。
16.en: When they had laid many stripes on them, they threw them into prison, charging the jailer to keep them safely.

16.zh: 禁卒领了这样的命，就把他们下在内监里，两脚上了木狗。
16.en: Having received such a command, he threw them into the inner prison and secured their feet in the stocks.

16.zh: 约在半夜，保罗和西拉祷告，唱诗赞美　神，众囚犯也侧耳而听。
16.en: But about midnight Paul and Silas were praying and singing hymns to God, and the prisoners were listening to them.

16.zh: 忽然，地大震动，甚至监牢的地基都摇动了，监门立刻全开，众囚犯的锁链也都松开了。
16.en: Suddenly there was a great earthquake, so that the foundations of the prison were shaken; and immediately all the doors were opened, and everyone’s bonds were loosened.

16.zh: 禁卒一醒，看见监门全开，以为囚犯已经逃走，就拔刀要自杀。
16.en: The jailer, being roused out of sleep and seeing the prison doors open, drew his sword and was about to kill himself, supposing that the prisoners had escaped.

16.zh: 保罗大声呼叫说：「不要伤害自己！我们都在这里。」
16.en: But Paul cried with a loud voice, saying, “Don’t harm yourself, for we are all here!”

16.zh: 禁卒叫人拿灯来，就跳进去，战战兢兢地俯伏在保罗、西拉面前；
16.en: He called for lights, sprang in, fell down trembling before Paul and Silas,

16.zh: 又领他们出来，说：「二位先生，我当怎样行才可以得救？」
16.en: brought them out, and said, “Sirs, what must I do to be saved?”

16.zh: 他们说：「当信主耶稣，你和你一家都必得救。」
16.en: They said, “Believe in the Lord Jesus Christ, and you will be saved, you and your household.”

16.zh: 他们就把主的道讲给他和他全家的人听。
16.en: They spoke the word of the Lord to him, and to all who were in his house.

16.zh: 当夜，就在那时候，禁卒把他们带去，洗他们的伤；他和属乎他的人立时都受了洗。
16.en: He took them the same hour of the night and washed their stripes, and was immediately baptized, he and all his household.

16.zh: 于是禁卒领他们上自己家里去，给他们摆上饭。他和全家，因为信了　神，都很喜乐。
16.en: He brought them up into his house and set food before them, and rejoiced greatly with all his household, having believed in God.

16.zh: 到了天亮，官长打发差役来，说：「释放那两个人吧。」
16.en: But when it was day, the magistrates sent the sergeants, saying, “Let those men go.”

16.zh: 禁卒就把这话告诉保罗说：「官长打发人来叫释放你们，如今可以出监，平平安安地去吧。」
16.en: The jailer reported these words to Paul, saying, “The magistrates have sent to let you go; now therefore come out and go in peace.”

16.zh: 保罗却说：「我们是罗马人，并没有定罪，他们就在众人面前打了我们，又把我们下在监里，现在要私下撵我们出去吗？这是不行的。叫他们自己来领我们出去吧！」
16.en: But Paul said to them, “They have beaten us publicly without a trial, men who are Romans, and have cast us into prison! Do they now release us secretly? No, most certainly, but let them come themselves and bring us out!”

16.zh: 差役把这话回禀官长。官长听见他们是罗马人，就害怕了，
16.en: The sergeants reported these words to the magistrates, and they were afraid when they heard that they were Romans,

16.zh: 于是来劝他们，领他们出来，请他们离开那城。
16.en: and they came and begged them. When they had brought them out, they asked them to depart from the city.

16.zh: 二人出了监，往吕底亚家里去，见了弟兄们，劝慰他们一番，就走了。
16.en: They went out of the prison and entered into Lydia’s house. When they had seen the brothers, they encouraged them, then departed.

17.zh: 保罗和西拉经过暗妃坡里、亚波罗尼亚，来到帖撒罗尼迦，在那里有犹太人的会堂。
17.en: Now when they had passed through Amphipolis and Apollonia, they came to Thessalonica, where there was a Jewish synagogue.

17.zh: 保罗照他素常的规矩进去，一连三个安息日，本着圣经与他们辩论，
17.en: Paul, as was his custom, went in to them; and for three Sabbath days reasoned with them from the Scriptures,

17.zh: 讲解陈明基督必须受害，从死里复活；又说：「我所传与你们的这位耶稣就是基督。」
17.en: explaining and demonstrating that the Christ had to suffer and rise again from the dead, and saying, “This Jesus, whom I proclaim to you, is the Christ.”

17.zh: 他们中间有些人听了劝，就附从保罗和西拉，并有许多虔敬的希腊人，尊贵的妇女也不少。
17.en: Some of them were persuaded and joined Paul and Silas: of the devout Greeks a great multitude, and not a few of the chief women.

17.zh: 但那[不信的]犹太人心里嫉妒，招聚了些市井匪类，搭伙成群，耸动合城的人闯进耶孙的家，要将保罗、西拉带到百姓那里。
17.en: But the unpersuaded Jews took along some wicked men from the marketplace and gathering a crowd, set the city in an uproar. Assaulting the house of Jason, they sought to bring them out to the people.

17.zh: 找不着他们，就把耶孙和几个弟兄拉到地方官那里，喊叫说：「那搅乱天下的也到这里来了，
17.en: When they didn’t find them, they dragged Jason and certain brothers before the rulers of the city, crying, “These who have turned the world upside down have come here also,

17.zh: 耶孙收留他们。这些人都违背凯撒的命令，说另有一个王耶稣。」
17.en: whom Jason has received. These all act contrary to the decrees of Caesar, saying that there is another king, Jesus!”

17.zh: 众人和地方官听见这话，就惊慌了；
17.en: The multitude and the rulers of the city were troubled when they heard these things.

17.zh: 于是取了耶孙和其余之人的保状，就释放了他们。
17.en: When they had taken security from Jason and the rest, they let them go.

17.zh: 弟兄们随即在夜间打发保罗和西拉往庇哩亚去。二人到了，就进入犹太人的会堂。
17.en: The brothers immediately sent Paul and Silas away by night to Beroea. When they arrived, they went into the Jewish synagogue.

17.zh: 这地方的人贤于帖撒罗尼迦的人，甘心领受这道，天天考查圣经，要晓得这道是与不是。
17.en: Now these were more noble than those in Thessalonica, in that they received the word with all readiness of mind, examining the Scriptures daily to see whether these things were so.

17.zh: 所以他们中间多有相信的，又有希腊尊贵的妇女，男子也不少。
17.en: Many of them therefore believed; also of the prominent Greek women, and not a few men.

17.zh: 但帖撒罗尼迦的犹太人知道保罗又在庇哩亚传　神的道，也就往那里去，耸动搅扰众人。
17.en: But when the Jews of Thessalonica had knowledge that the word of God was proclaimed by Paul at Beroea also, they came there likewise, agitating the multitudes.

17.zh: 当时弟兄们便打发保罗往海边去，西拉和提摩太仍住在庇哩亚。
17.en: Then the brothers immediately sent out Paul to go as far as to the sea, and Silas and Timothy still stayed there.

17.zh: 送保罗的人带他到了雅典，既领了保罗的命，叫西拉和提摩太速速到他这里来，就回去了。
17.en: But those who escorted Paul brought him as far as Athens. Receiving a commandment to Silas and Timothy that they should come to him very quickly, they departed.

17.zh: 保罗在雅典等候他们的时候，看见满城都是偶像，就心里着急；
17.en: Now while Paul waited for them at Athens, his spirit was provoked within him as he saw the city full of idols.

17.zh: 于是在会堂里与犹太人和虔敬的人，并每日在市上所遇见的人，辩论。
17.en: So he reasoned in the synagogue with the Jews and the devout persons, and in the marketplace every day with those who met him.

17.zh: 还有伊壁鸠鲁和斯多亚两门的学士，与他争论。有的说：「这胡言乱语的要说什么？」有的说：「他似乎是传说外邦鬼神的。」这话是因保罗传讲耶稣与复活的道。
17.en: Some of the Epicurean and Stoic philosophers also were conversing with him. Some said, “What does this babbler want to say?” Others said, “He seems to be advocating foreign deities,” because he preached Jesus and the resurrection.

17.zh: 他们就把他带到亚略·巴古，说：「你所讲的这新道，我们也可以知道吗？
17.en: They took hold of him and brought him to the Areopagus, saying, “May we know what this new teaching is, which you are speaking about?

17.zh: 因为你有些奇怪的事传到我们耳中，我们愿意知道这些事是什么意思。」（
17.en: For you bring certain strange things to our ears. We want to know therefore what these things mean.”

17.zh: 雅典人和住在那里的客人都不顾别的事，只将新闻说说听听。）
17.en: Now all the Athenians and the strangers living there spent their time in nothing else, but either to tell or to hear some new thing.

17.zh: 保罗站在亚略·巴古当中，说：「众位雅典人哪，我看你们凡事很敬畏鬼神。
17.en: Paul stood in the middle of the Areopagus and said, “You men of Athens, I perceive that you are very religious in all things.

17.zh: 我游行的时候，观看你们所敬拜的，遇见一座坛，上面写着『未识之神』。你们所不认识而敬拜的，我现在告诉你们。
17.en: For as I passed along and observed the objects of your worship, I also found an altar with this inscription: ‘TO AN UNKNOWN GOD.’ What therefore you worship in ignorance, I announce to you.

17.zh: 创造宇宙和其中万物的　神，既是天地的主，就不住人手所造的殿，
17.en: The God who made the world and all things in it, he, being Lord of heaven and earth, doesn’t dwell in temples made with hands.

17.zh: 也不用人手服事，好像缺少什么；自己倒将生命、气息、万物，赐给万人。
17.en: He isn’t served by men’s hands, as though he needed anything, seeing he himself gives to all life and breath and all things.

17.zh: 他从一本造出万族的人，住在全地上，并且预先定准他们的年限和所住的疆界，
17.en: He made from one blood every nation of men to dwell on all the surface of the earth, having determined appointed seasons and the boundaries of their dwellings,

17.zh: 要叫他们寻求　神，或者可以揣摩而得，其实他离我们各人不远；
17.en: that they should seek the Lord, if perhaps they might reach out for him and find him, though he is not far from each one of us.

17.zh: 我们生活、动作、存留，都在乎他。就如你们作诗的，有人说：『我们也是他所生的。』
17.en: ‘For in him we live, move, and have our being.’ As some of your own poets have said, ‘For we are also his offspring.’

17.zh: 我们既是　神所生的，就不当以为　神的神性像人用手艺、心思所雕刻的金、银、石。
17.en: Being then the offspring of God, we ought not to think that the Divine Nature is like gold, or silver, or stone, engraved by art and design of man.

17.zh: 世人蒙昧无知的时候，　神并不监察，如今却吩咐各处的人都要悔改。
17.en: The times of ignorance therefore God overlooked. But now he commands that all people everywhere should repent,

17.zh: 因为他已经定了日子，要借着他所设立的人按公义审判天下，并且叫他从死里复活，给万人作可信的凭据。」
17.en: because he has appointed a day in which he will judge the world in righteousness by the man whom he has ordained; of which he has given assurance to all men, in that he has raised him from the dead.”

17.zh: 众人听见从死里复活的话，就有讥诮他的；又有人说：「我们再听你讲这个吧！」
17.en: Now when they heard of the resurrection of the dead, some mocked; but others said, “We want to hear you again concerning this.”

17.zh: 于是保罗从他们当中出去了。
17.en: Thus Paul went out from among them.

17.zh: 但有几个人贴近他，信了[主]，其中有亚略·巴古的官丢尼修，并一个妇人，名叫大马哩，还有别人一同信从。
17.en: But certain men joined with him and believed, including Dionysius the Areopagite, and a woman named Damaris, and others with them.

18.zh: 这事以后，保罗离了雅典，来到哥林多。
18.en: After these things Paul departed from Athens and came to Corinth.

18.zh: 遇见一个犹太人，名叫亚居拉，他生在本都；因为克劳第命犹太人都离开罗马，新近带着妻百基拉，从意大利来。保罗就投奔了他们。
18.en: He found a certain Jew named Aquila, a man of Pontus by race, who had recently come from Italy with his wife Priscilla, because Claudius had commanded all the Jews to depart from Rome. He came to them,

18.zh: 他们本是制造帐棚为业。保罗因与他们同业，就和他们同住做工。
18.en: and because he practiced the same trade, he lived with them and worked, for by trade they were tent makers.

18.zh: 每逢安息日，保罗在会堂里辩论，劝化犹太人和希腊人。
18.en: He reasoned in the synagogue every Sabbath and persuaded Jews and Greeks.

18.zh: 西拉和提摩太从马其顿来的时候，保罗为道迫切，向犹太人证明耶稣是基督。
18.en: When Silas and Timothy came down from Macedonia, Paul was compelled by the Spirit, testifying to the Jews that Jesus was the Christ.

18.zh: 他们既抗拒、毁谤，保罗就抖着衣裳，说：「你们的罪归到你们自己头上，与我无干。从今以后，我要往外邦人那里去。」
18.en: When they opposed him and blasphemed, he shook out his clothing and said to them, “Your blood be on your own heads! I am clean. From now on, I will go to the Gentiles!”

18.zh: 于是离开那里，到了一个人的家中；这人名叫提多·犹士都，是敬拜　神的，他的家靠近会堂。
18.en: He departed there and went into the house of a certain man named Justus, one who worshiped God, whose house was next door to the synagogue.

18.zh: 管会堂的基利司布和全家都信了主，还有许多哥林多人听了，就相信受洗。
18.en: Crispus, the ruler of the synagogue, believed in the Lord with all his house. Many of the Corinthians, when they heard, believed and were baptized.

18.zh: 夜间，主在异象中对保罗说：「不要怕，只管讲，不要闭口，
18.en: The Lord said to Paul in the night by a vision, “Don’t be afraid, but speak and don’t be silent;

18.zh: 有我与你同在，必没有人下手害你，因为在这城里我有许多的百姓。」
18.en: for I am with you, and no one will attack you to harm you, for I have many people in this city.”

18.zh: 保罗在那里住了一年零六个月，将　神的道教训他们。
18.en: He lived there a year and six months, teaching the word of God among them.

18.zh: 到迦流作亚该亚方伯的时候，犹太人同心起来攻击保罗，拉他到公堂，
18.en: But when Gallio was proconsul of Achaia, the Jews with one accord rose up against Paul and brought him before the judgment seat,

18.zh: 说：「这个人劝人不按着律法敬拜　神。」
18.en: saying, “This man persuades men to worship God contrary to the law.”

18.zh: 保罗刚要开口，迦流就对犹太人说：「你们这些犹太人！如果是为冤枉或奸恶的事，我理当耐性听你们。
18.en: But when Paul was about to open his mouth, Gallio said to the Jews, “If indeed it were a matter of wrong or of wicked crime, you Jews, it would be reasonable that I should bear with you;

18.zh: 但所争论的，若是关乎言语、名目，和你们的律法，你们自己去办吧！这样的事我不愿意审问」；
18.en: but if they are questions about words and names and your own law, look to it yourselves. For I don’t want to be a judge of these matters.”

18.zh: 就把他们撵出公堂。
18.en: So he drove them from the judgment seat.

18.zh: 众人便揪住管会堂的所提尼，在堂前打他。这些事迦流都不管。
18.en: Then all the Greeks seized Sosthenes, the ruler of the synagogue, and beat him before the judgment seat. Gallio didn’t care about any of these things.

18.zh: 保罗又住了多日，就辞别了弟兄，坐船往叙利亚去；百基拉、亚居拉和他同去。他因为许过愿，就在坚革哩剪了头发。
18.en: Paul, having stayed after this many more days, took his leave of the brothers, and sailed from there for Syria, together with Priscilla and Aquila. He shaved his head in Cenchreae, for he had a vow.

18.zh: 到了以弗所，保罗就把他们留在那里，自己进了会堂，和犹太人辩论。
18.en: He came to Ephesus, and he left them there; but he himself entered into the synagogue and reasoned with the Jews.

18.zh: 众人请他多住些日子，他却不允，
18.en: When they asked him to stay with them a longer time, he declined;

18.zh: 就辞别他们，说：「　神若许我，我还要回到你们这里」；于是开船离了以弗所。
18.en: but taking his leave of them, he said, “I must by all means keep this coming feast in Jerusalem, but I will return again to you if God wills.” Then he set sail from Ephesus.

18.zh: 在凯撒利亚下了船，就上[耶路撒冷]去问教会安，随后下安提阿去。
18.en: When he had landed at Caesarea, he went up and greeted the assembly, and went down to Antioch.

18.zh: 住了些日子，又离开那里，挨次经过加拉太和弗吕家地方，坚固众门徒。
18.en: Having spent some time there, he departed and went through the region of Galatia and Phrygia, in order, establishing all the disciples.

18.zh: 有一个犹太人，名叫亚波罗，来到以弗所。他生在亚历山大，是有学问的，最能讲解圣经。
18.en: Now a certain Jew named Apollos, an Alexandrian by race, an eloquent man, came to Ephesus. He was mighty in the Scriptures.

18.zh: 这人已经在主的道上受了教训，心里火热，将耶稣的事详细讲论教训人；只是他单晓得约翰的洗礼。
18.en: This man had been instructed in the way of the Lord; and being fervent in spirit, he spoke and taught accurately the things concerning Jesus, although he knew only the baptism of John.

18.zh: 他在会堂里放胆讲道；百基拉、亚居拉听见，就接他来，将　神的道给他讲解更加详细。
18.en: He began to speak boldly in the synagogue. But when Priscilla and Aquila heard him, they took him aside, and explained to him the way of God more accurately.

18.zh: 他想要往亚该亚去，弟兄们就勉励他，并写信请门徒接待他。他到了那里，多帮助那蒙恩信主的人，
18.en: When he had determined to pass over into Achaia, the brothers encouraged him; and wrote to the disciples to receive him. When he had come, he greatly helped those who had believed through grace;

18.zh: 在众人面前极有能力驳倒犹太人，引圣经证明耶稣是基督。
18.en: for he powerfully refuted the Jews, publicly showing by the Scriptures that Jesus was the Christ.

19.zh: 亚波罗在哥林多的时候，保罗经过了上边一带地方，就来到以弗所；在那里遇见几个门徒，
19.en: While Apollos was at Corinth, Paul, having passed through the upper country, came to Ephesus and found certain disciples.

19.zh: 问他们说：「你们信的时候受了圣灵没有？」他们回答说：「没有，也未曾听见有圣灵[赐下来]。」
19.en: He said to them, “Did you receive the Holy Spirit when you believed?” They said to him, “No, we haven’t even heard that there is a Holy Spirit.”

19.zh: 保罗说：「这样，你们受的是什么洗呢？」他们说：「是约翰的洗。」
19.en: He said, “Into what then were you baptized?” They said, “Into John’s baptism.”

19.zh: 保罗说：「约翰所行的是悔改的洗，告诉百姓当信那在他以后要来的，就是耶稣。」
19.en: Paul said, “John indeed baptized with the baptism of repentance, saying to the people that they should believe in the one who would come after him, that is, in Christ Jesus.”

19.zh: 他们听见这话，就奉主耶稣的名受洗。
19.en: When they heard this, they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.

19.zh: 保罗按手在他们[头]上，圣灵便降在他们身上，他们就说方言，又说预言。
19.en: When Paul had laid his hands on them, the Holy Spirit came on them and they spoke with other languages and prophesied.

19.zh: 一共约有十二个人。
19.en: They were about twelve men in all.

19.zh: 保罗进会堂，放胆讲道，一连三个月，辩论　神国的事，劝化众人。
19.en: He entered into the synagogue and spoke boldly for a period of three months, reasoning and persuading about the things concerning God’s Kingdom.

19.zh: 后来，有些人心里刚硬不信，在众人面前毁谤这道，保罗就离开他们，也叫门徒与他们分离，便在推喇奴的学房天天辩论。
19.en: But when some were hardened and disobedient, speaking evil of the Way before the multitude, he departed from them and separated the disciples, reasoning daily in the school of Tyrannus.

19.zh: 这样有两年之久，叫一切住在亚细亚的，无论是犹太人，是希腊人，都听见主的道。
19.en: This continued for two years, so that all those who lived in Asia heard the word of the Lord Jesus, both Jews and Greeks.

19.zh: 神借保罗的手行了些非常的奇事；
19.en: God worked special miracles by the hands of Paul,

19.zh: 甚至有人从保罗身上拿手巾或围裙放在病人身上，病就退了，恶鬼也出去了。
19.en: so that even handkerchiefs or aprons were carried away from his body to the sick, and the diseases departed from them, and the evil spirits went out.

19.zh: 那时，有几个游行各处、念咒赶鬼的犹太人，向那被恶鬼附的人擅自称主耶稣的名，说：「我奉保罗所传的耶稣敕令你们出来！」
19.en: But some of the itinerant Jews, exorcists, took on themselves to invoke over those who had the evil spirits the name of the Lord Jesus, saying, “We adjure you by Jesus whom Paul preaches.”

19.zh: 做这事的，有犹太祭司长士基瓦的七个儿子。
19.en: There were seven sons of one Sceva, a Jewish chief priest, who did this.

19.zh: 恶鬼回答他们说：「耶稣我认识，保罗我也知道。你们却是谁呢？」
19.en: The evil spirit answered, “Jesus I know, and Paul I know, but who are you?”

19.zh: 恶鬼所附的人就跳在他们身上，胜了其中二人，制伏他们，叫他们赤着身子受了伤，从那房子里逃出去了。
19.en: The man in whom the evil spirit was leaped on them, overpowered them, and prevailed against them, so that they fled out of that house naked and wounded.

19.zh: 凡住在以弗所的，无论是犹太人，是希腊人，都知道这事，也都惧怕；主耶稣的名从此就尊大了。
19.en: This became known to all, both Jews and Greeks, who lived at Ephesus. Fear fell on them all, and the name of the Lord Jesus was magnified.

19.zh: 那已经信的，多有人来承认诉说自己所行的事。
19.en: Many also of those who had believed came, confessing and declaring their deeds.

19.zh: 平素行邪术的，也有许多人把书拿来，堆积在众人面前焚烧。他们算计书价，便知道共合五万块钱。
19.en: Many of those who practiced magical arts brought their books together and burned them in the sight of all. They counted their price, and found it to be fifty thousand pieces of silver.

19.zh: 主的道大大兴旺，而且得胜，就是这样。
19.en: So the word of the Lord was growing and becoming mighty.

19.zh: 这些事完了，保罗心里定意经过了马其顿、亚该亚，就往耶路撒冷去；又说：「我到了那里以后，也必须往罗马去看看。」
19.en: Now after these things had ended, Paul determined in the Spirit, when he had passed through Macedonia and Achaia, to go to Jerusalem, saying, “After I have been there, I must also see Rome.”

19.zh: 于是从帮助他的人中打发提摩太、以拉都二人往马其顿去，自己暂时等在亚细亚。
19.en: Having sent into Macedonia two of those who served him, Timothy and Erastus, he himself stayed in Asia for a while.

19.zh: 那时，因为这道起的扰乱不小。
19.en: About that time there arose no small disturbance concerning the Way.

19.zh: 有一个银匠，名叫底米丢，是制造亚底米神银龛的，他使这样手艺人生意发达。
19.en: For a certain man named Demetrius, a silversmith who made silver shrines of Artemis, brought no little business to the craftsmen,

19.zh: 他聚集他们和同行的工人，说：「众位，你们知道我们是倚靠这生意发财。
19.en: whom he gathered together with the workmen of like occupation, and said, “Sirs, you know that by this business we have our wealth.

19.zh: 这保罗不但在以弗所，也几乎在亚细亚全地，引诱迷惑许多人，说：『人手所做的，不是神。』这是你们所看见所听见的。
19.en: You see and hear that not at Ephesus alone, but almost throughout all Asia, this Paul has persuaded and turned away many people, saying that they are no gods that are made with hands.

19.zh: 这样，不独我们这事业被人藐视，就是大女神亚底米的庙也要被人轻忽，连亚细亚全地和普天下所敬拜的大女神之威荣也要消灭了。」
19.en: Not only is there danger that this our trade come into disrepute, but also that the temple of the great goddess Artemis will be counted as nothing and her majesty destroyed, whom all Asia and the world worships.”

19.zh: 众人听见，就怒气填胸，喊着说：「大哉，以弗所人的亚底米啊！」
19.en: When they heard this they were filled with anger, and cried out, saying, “Great is Artemis of the Ephesians!”

19.zh: 满城都轰动起来。众人拿住与保罗同行的马其顿人该犹和亚里达古，齐心拥进戏园里去。
19.en: The whole city was filled with confusion, and they rushed with one accord into the theater, having seized Gaius and Aristarchus, men of Macedonia, Paul’s companions in travel.

19.zh: 保罗想要进去，到百姓那里，门徒却不许他去。
19.en: When Paul wanted to enter in to the people, the disciples didn’t allow him.

19.zh: 还有亚细亚几位首领，是保罗的朋友，打发人来劝他，不要冒险到戏园里去。
19.en: Certain also of the Asiarchs, being his friends, sent to him and begged him not to venture into the theater.

19.zh: 聚集的人纷纷乱乱，有喊叫这个的，有喊叫那个的；大半不知道是为什么聚集。
19.en: Some therefore cried one thing, and some another, for the assembly was in confusion. Most of them didn’t know why they had come together.

19.zh: 有人把亚历山大从众人中带出来，犹太人推他往前，亚历山大就摆手，要向百姓分诉；
19.en: They brought Alexander out of the multitude, the Jews putting him forward. Alexander beckoned with his hand, and would have made a defense to the people.

19.zh: 只因他们认出他是犹太人，就大家同声喊着说：「大哉！以弗所人的亚底米啊。」如此约有两小时。
19.en: But when they perceived that he was a Jew, all with one voice for a time of about two hours cried out, “Great is Artemis of the Ephesians!”

19.zh: 那城里的书记安抚了众人，就说：「以弗所人哪，谁不知道以弗所人的城是看守大亚底米的庙和从宙斯那里落下来的[像]呢？
19.en: When the town clerk had quieted the multitude, he said, “You men of Ephesus, what man is there who doesn’t know that the city of the Ephesians is temple keeper of the great goddess Artemis, and of the image which fell down from Zeus?

19.zh: 这事既是驳不倒的，你们就当安静，不可造次。
19.en: Seeing then that these things can’t be denied, you ought to be quiet and to do nothing rash.

19.zh: 你们把这些人带来，他们并没有偷窃庙中之物，也没有谤 我们的女神。
19.en: For you have brought these men here, who are neither robbers of temples nor blasphemers of your goddess.

19.zh: 若是底米丢和他同行的人有控告人的事，自有放告的日子，也有方伯可以彼此对告。
19.en: If therefore Demetrius and the craftsmen who are with him have a matter against anyone, the courts are open and there are proconsuls. Let them press charges against one another.

19.zh: 你们若问别的事，就可以照常例聚集断定。
19.en: But if you seek anything about other matters, it will be settled in the regular assembly.

19.zh: 今日的扰乱本是无缘无故，我们难免被查问。论到这样聚众，我们也说不出所以然来。」
19.en: For indeed we are in danger of being accused concerning today’s riot, there being no cause. Concerning it, we wouldn’t be able to give an account of this commotion.”

19.zh: 说了这话，便叫众人散去。
19.en: When he had thus spoken, he dismissed the assembly.

20.zh: 乱定之后，保罗请门徒来，劝勉他们，就辞别起行，往马其顿去。
20.en: After the uproar had ceased, Paul sent for the disciples, took leave of them, and departed to go into Macedonia.

20.zh: 走遍了那一带地方，用许多话劝勉门徒，然后来到希腊。
20.en: When he had gone through those parts and had encouraged them with many words, he came into Greece.

20.zh: 在那里住了三个月，将要坐船往叙利亚去，犹太人设计要害他，他就定意从马其顿回去。
20.en: When he had spent three months there, and a plot was made against him by Jews as he was about to set sail for Syria, he determined to return through Macedonia.

20.zh: 同他到亚细亚去的，有庇哩亚人毕罗斯的儿子所巴特，帖撒罗尼迦人亚里达古和西公都，还有特庇人该犹，并提摩太，又有亚细亚人推基古和特罗非摩。
20.en: These accompanied him as far as Asia: Sopater of Beroea, Aristarchus and Secundus of the Thessalonians, Gaius of Derbe, Timothy, and Tychicus and Trophimus of Asia.

20.zh: 这些人先走，在特罗亚等候我们。
20.en: But these had gone ahead, and were waiting for us at Troas.

20.zh: 过了除酵的日子，我们从腓立比开船，五天到了特罗亚，和他们相会，在那里住了七天。
20.en: We sailed away from Philippi after the days of Unleavened Bread, and came to them at Troas in five days, where we stayed seven days.

20.zh: 七日的第一日，我们聚会擘饼的时候，保罗因为要次日起行，就与他们讲论，直讲到半夜。
20.en: On the first day of the week, when the disciples were gathered together to break bread, Paul talked with them, intending to depart on the next day; and continued his speech until midnight.

20.zh: 我们聚会的那座楼上，有好些灯烛。
20.en: There were many lights in the upper room where we were gathered together.

20.zh: 有一个少年人，名叫犹推古，坐在窗台上，困倦沉睡。保罗讲了多时，少年人睡熟了，就从三层楼上掉下去；扶起他来，已经死了。
20.en: A certain young man named Eutychus sat in the window, weighed down with deep sleep. As Paul spoke still longer, being weighed down by his sleep, he fell down from the third floor and was taken up dead.

20.zh: 保罗下去，伏在他身上，抱着他，说：「你们不要发慌，他的灵魂还在身上。」
20.en: Paul went down and fell upon him, and embracing him said, “Don’t be troubled, for his life is in him.”

20.zh: 保罗又上去，擘饼，吃了，谈论许久，直到天亮，这才走了。
20.en: When he had gone up, had broken bread and eaten, and had talked with them a long while, even until break of day, he departed.

20.zh: 有人把那童子活活地领来，得的安慰不小。
20.en: They brought the boy in alive, and were greatly comforted.

20.zh: 我们先上船，开往亚朔去，意思要在那里接保罗；因为他是这样安排的，他自己打算要步行。
20.en: But we, going ahead to the ship, set sail for Assos, intending to take Paul aboard there; for he had so arranged, intending himself to go by land.

20.zh: 他既在亚朔与我们相会，我们就接他上船，来到米推利尼。
20.en: When he met us at Assos, we took him aboard and came to Mitylene.

20.zh: 从那里开船，次日到了基阿的对面；又次日，在撒摩靠岸；又次日，来到米利都。
20.en: Sailing from there, we came the following day opposite Chios. The next day we touched at Samos and stayed at Trogyllium, and the day after we came to Miletus.

20.zh: 乃因保罗早已定意越过以弗所，免得在亚细亚耽延，他急忙前走，巴不得赶五旬节能到耶路撒冷。
20.en: For Paul had determined to sail past Ephesus, that he might not have to spend time in Asia; for he was hastening, if it were possible for him, to be in Jerusalem on the day of Pentecost.

20.zh: 保罗从米利都打发人往以弗所去，请教会的长老来。
20.en: From Miletus he sent to Ephesus and called to himself the elders of the assembly.

20.zh: 他们来了，保罗就说：「你们知道，自从我到亚细亚的日子以来，在你们中间始终为人如何，
20.en: When they had come to him, he said to them, “You yourselves know, from the first day that I set foot in Asia, how I was with you all the time,

20.zh: 服事主，凡事谦卑，眼中流泪，又因犹太人的谋害，经历试炼。
20.en: serving the Lord with all humility, with many tears, and with trials which happened to me by the plots of the Jews;

20.zh: 你们也知道，凡与你们有益的，我没有一样避讳不说的，或在众人面前，或在各人家里，我都教导你们；
20.en: how I didn’t shrink from declaring to you anything that was profitable, teaching you publicly and from house to house,

20.zh: 又对犹太人和希腊人证明当向　神悔改，信靠我主耶稣基督。
20.en: testifying both to Jews and to Greeks repentance toward God and faith toward our Lord Jesus.

20.zh: 现在我往耶路撒冷去，心甚迫切，不知道在那里要遇见什么事；
20.en: Now, behold, I go bound by the Spirit to Jerusalem, not knowing what will happen to me there;

20.zh: 但知道圣灵在各城里向我指证，说有捆锁与患难等待我。
20.en: except that the Holy Spirit testifies in every city, saying that bonds and afflictions wait for me.

20.zh: 我却不以性命为念，也不看为宝贵，只要行完我的路程，成就我从主耶稣所领受的职事，证明　神恩惠的福音。
20.en: But these things don’t count; nor do I hold my life dear to myself, so that I may finish my race with joy, and the ministry which I received from the Lord Jesus, to fully testify to the Good News of the grace of God.

20.zh: 「我素常在你们中间来往，传讲　神国[的道]；如今我晓得，你们以后都不得再见我的面了。
20.en: “Now, behold, I know that you all, among whom I went about preaching God’s Kingdom, will see my face no more.

20.zh: 所以我今日向你们证明，你们中间无论何人死亡，罪不在我身上。
20.en: Therefore I testify to you today that I am clean from the blood of all men,

20.zh: 因为　神的旨意，我并没有一样避讳不传给你们的。
20.en: for I didn’t shrink from declaring to you the whole counsel of God.

20.zh: 圣灵立你们作全群的监督，你们就当为自己谨慎，也为全群谨慎，牧养　神的教会，就是他用自己血所买来的。
20.en: Take heed, therefore, to yourselves and to all the flock, in which the Holy Spirit has made you overseers, to shepherd the assembly of the Lord and God which he purchased with his own blood.

20.zh: 我知道，我去之后必有凶暴的豺狼进入你们中间，不爱惜羊群。
20.en: For I know that after my departure, vicious wolves will enter in among you, not sparing the flock.

20.zh: 就是你们中间，也必有人起来说悖谬的话，要引诱门徒跟从他们。
20.en: Men will arise from among your own selves, speaking perverse things, to draw away the disciples after them.

20.zh: 所以你们应当警醒，记念我三年之久昼夜不住地流泪、劝戒你们各人。
20.en: Therefore watch, remembering that for a period of three years I didn’t cease to admonish everyone night and day with tears.

20.zh: 如今我把你们交托　神和他恩惠的道；这道能建立你们，叫你们和一切成圣的人同得基业。
20.en: Now, brothers, I entrust you to God and to the word of his grace, which is able to build up and to give you the inheritance among all those who are sanctified.

20.zh: 我未曾贪图一个人的金、银、衣服。
20.en: I coveted no one’s silver, gold, or clothing.

20.zh: 我这两只手常供给我和同人的需用，这是你们自己知道的。
20.en: You yourselves know that these hands served my necessities, and those who were with me.

20.zh: 我凡事给你们作榜样，叫你们知道应当这样劳苦，扶助软弱的人，又当记念主耶稣的话，说：『施比受更为有福。』」
20.en: In all things I gave you an example, that so laboring you ought to help the weak, and to remember the words of the Lord Jesus, that he himself said, ‘It is more blessed to give than to receive.’ ”

20.zh: 保罗说完了这话，就跪下同众人祷告。
20.en: When he had spoken these things, he knelt down and prayed with them all.

20.zh: 众人痛哭，抱着保罗的颈项，和他亲嘴。
20.en: They all wept freely, and fell on Paul’s neck and kissed him,

20.zh: 叫他们最伤心的，就是他说「以后不能再见我的面」那句话，于是送他上船去了。
20.en: sorrowing most of all because of the word which he had spoken, that they should see his face no more. Then they accompanied him to the ship.

21.zh: 我们离别了众人，就开船一直行到哥士。第二天到了罗底，从那里到帕大喇，
21.en: When we had departed from them and had set sail, we came with a straight course to Cos, and the next day to Rhodes, and from there to Patara.

21.zh: 遇见一只船要往腓尼基去，就上船起行。
21.en: Having found a ship crossing over to Phoenicia, we went aboard and set sail.

21.zh: 望见塞浦路斯，就从南边行过，往叙利亚去，我们就在泰尔上岸，因为船要在那里卸货。
21.en: When we had come in sight of Cyprus, leaving it on the left hand, we sailed to Syria and landed at Tyre, for the ship was there to unload her cargo.

21.zh: 找着了门徒，就在那里住了七天。他们被圣灵感动，对保罗说：「不要上耶路撒冷去。」
21.en: Having found disciples, we stayed there seven days. These said to Paul through the Spirit that he should not go up to Jerusalem.

21.zh: 过了这几天，我们就起身前行。他们众人同妻子儿女，送我们到城外，我们都跪在岸上祷告，彼此辞别。
21.en: When those days were over, we departed and went on our journey. They all, with wives and children, brought us on our way until we were out of the city. Kneeling down on the beach, we prayed.

21.zh: 我们上了船，他们就回家去了。
21.en: After saying goodbye to each other, we went on board the ship, and they returned home again.

21.zh: 我们从泰尔行尽了水路，来到多利买，就问那里的弟兄安，和他们同住了一天。
21.en: When we had finished the voyage from Tyre, we arrived at Ptolemais. We greeted the brothers and stayed with them one day.

21.zh: 第二天，我们离开那里，来到凯撒利亚，就进了传福音的腓利家里，和他同住。他是那七个[执事]里的一个。
21.en: On the next day, we who were Paul’s companions departed and came to Caesarea. We entered into the house of Philip the evangelist, who was one of the seven, and stayed with him.

21.zh: 他有四个女儿，都是处女，是说预言的。
21.en: Now this man had four virgin daughters who prophesied.

21.zh: 我们在那里多住了几天，有一个先知，名叫亚迦布，从犹太下来，
21.en: As we stayed there some days, a certain prophet named Agabus came down from Judea.

21.zh: 到了我们这里，就拿保罗的腰带捆上自己的手脚，说：「圣灵说：犹太人在耶路撒冷，要如此捆绑这腰带的主人，把他交在外邦人手里。」
21.en: Coming to us and taking Paul’s belt, he bound his own feet and hands, and said, “The Holy Spirit says: ‘So the Jews at Jerusalem will bind the man who owns this belt, and will deliver him into the hands of the Gentiles.’”

21.zh: 我们和那本地的人听见这话，都苦劝保罗不要上耶路撒冷去。
21.en: When we heard these things, both we and the people of that place begged him not to go up to Jerusalem.

21.zh: 保罗说：「你们为什么这样痛哭，使我心碎呢？我为主耶稣的名，不但被人捆绑，就是死在耶路撒冷也是愿意的。」
21.en: Then Paul answered, “What are you doing, weeping and breaking my heart? For I am ready not only to be bound, but also to die at Jerusalem for the name of the Lord Jesus.”

21.zh: 保罗既不听劝，我们便住了口，只说：「愿主的旨意成就」，便了。
21.en: When he would not be persuaded, we ceased, saying, “The Lord’s will be done.”

21.zh: 过了几日，我们收拾行李上耶路撒冷去。
21.en: After these days we took up our baggage and went up to Jerusalem.

21.zh: 有凯撒利亚的几个门徒和我们同去，带我们到一个久为门徒的家里，叫我们与他同住；他名叫拿孙，是塞浦路斯人。
21.en: Some of the disciples from Caesarea also went with us, bringing one Mnason of Cyprus, an early disciple, with whom we would stay.

21.zh: 到了耶路撒冷，弟兄们欢欢喜喜地接待我们。
21.en: When we had come to Jerusalem, the brothers received us gladly.

21.zh: 第二天，保罗同我们去见雅各；长老们也都在那里。
21.en: The day following, Paul went in with us to James; and all the elders were present.

21.zh: 保罗问了他们安，便将　神用他传教，在外邦人中间所行之事，一一地述说了。
21.en: When he had greeted them, he reported one by one the things which God had worked among the Gentiles through his ministry.

21.zh: 他们听见，就归荣耀与　神，对保罗说：「兄台，你看犹太人中信主的有多少万，并且都为律法热心。
21.en: They, when they heard it, glorified God. They said to him, “You see, brother, how many thousands there are among the Jews of those who have believed, and they are all zealous for the law.

21.zh: 他们听见人说，你教训一切在外邦的犹太人离弃摩西，对他们说，不要给孩子行割礼，也不要遵行条规。
21.en: They have been informed about you, that you teach all the Jews who are among the Gentiles to forsake Moses, telling them not to circumcise their children and not to walk after the customs.

21.zh: 众人必听见你来了，这可怎么办呢？
21.en: What then? The assembly must certainly meet, for they will hear that you have come.

21.zh: 你就照着我们的话行吧！我们这里有四个人，都有愿在身。
21.en: Therefore do what we tell you. We have four men who have taken a vow.

21.zh: 你带他们去，与他们一同行洁净的礼，替他们拿出规费，叫他们得以剃头。这样，众人就可知道，先前所听见你的事都是虚的；并可知道，你自己为人，循规蹈矩，遵行律法。
21.en: Take them and purify yourself with them, and pay their expenses for them, that they may shave their heads. Then all will know that there is no truth in the things that they have been informed about you, but that you yourself also walk keeping the law.

21.zh: 至于信主的外邦人，我们已经写信拟定，叫他们谨忌那祭偶像之物，和血，并勒死的牲畜，与奸淫。」
21.en: But concerning the Gentiles who believe, we have written our decision that they should observe no such thing, except that they should keep themselves from food offered to idols, from blood, from strangled things, and from sexual immorality.”

21.zh: 于是保罗带着那四个人，第二天与他们一同行了洁净的礼，进了殿，报明洁净的日期满足，只等[祭司]为他们各人献祭。
21.en: Then Paul took the men, and the next day purified himself and went with them into the temple, declaring the fulfillment of the days of purification, until the offering was offered for every one of them.

21.zh: 那七日将完，从亚细亚来的犹太人看见保罗在殿里，就耸动了众人，下手拿他，
21.en: When the seven days were almost completed, the Jews from Asia, when they saw him in the temple, stirred up all the multitude and laid hands on him,

21.zh: 喊叫说：「以色列人来帮助，这就是在各处教训众人糟践[我们]百姓和律法，并这地方的。他又带着希腊人进殿，污秽了这圣地。」（
21.en: crying out, “Men of Israel, help! This is the man who teaches all men everywhere against the people, and the law, and this place. Moreover, he also brought Greeks into the temple and has defiled this holy place!”

21.zh: 这话是因他们曾看见以弗所人特罗非摩同保罗在城里，以为保罗带他进了殿。）
21.en: For they had seen Trophimus the Ephesian with him in the city, and they supposed that Paul had brought him into the temple.

21.zh: 合城都震动，百姓一齐跑来，拿住保罗，拉他出殿，殿门立刻都关了。
21.en: All the city was moved and the people ran together. They seized Paul and dragged him out of the temple. Immediately the doors were shut.

21.zh: 他们正想要杀他，有人报信给营里的千夫长说：「耶路撒冷合城都乱了。」
21.en: As they were trying to kill him, news came up to the commanding officer of the regiment that all Jerusalem was in an uproar.

21.zh: 千夫长立时带着兵丁和几个百夫长，跑下去到他们那里。他们见了千夫长和兵丁，就止住不打保罗。
21.en: Immediately he took soldiers and centurions and ran down to them. They, when they saw the chief captain and the soldiers, stopped beating Paul.

21.zh: 于是千夫长上前拿住他，吩咐用两条铁链捆锁；又问他是什么人，做的是什么事。
21.en: Then the commanding officer came near, arrested him, commanded him to be bound with two chains, and inquired who he was and what he had done.

21.zh: 众人有喊叫这个的，有喊叫那个的；千夫长因为这样乱嚷，得不着实情，就吩咐人将保罗带进营楼去。
21.en: Some shouted one thing and some another, among the crowd. When he couldn’t find out the truth because of the noise, he commanded him to be brought into the barracks.

21.zh: 到了台阶上，众人挤得凶猛，兵丁只得将保罗抬起来。
21.en: When he came to the stairs, he was carried by the soldiers because of the violence of the crowd;

21.zh: 众人跟在后面，喊着说：「除掉他！」
21.en: for the multitude of the people followed after, crying out, “Away with him!”

21.zh: 将要带他进营楼，保罗对千夫长说：「我对你说句话可以不可以？」他说：「你懂得希腊话吗？
21.en: As Paul was about to be brought into the barracks, he asked the commanding officer, “May I speak to you?” He said, “Do you know Greek?

21.zh: 你莫非是从前作乱、带领四千凶徒往旷野去的那埃及人吗？」
21.en: Aren’t you then the Egyptian who before these days stirred up to sedition and led out into the wilderness the four thousand men of the Assassins?”

21.zh: 保罗说：「我本是犹太人，生在基利家的大数，并不是无名小城的人。求你准我对百姓说话。」
21.en: But Paul said, “I am a Jew from Tarsus in Cilicia, a citizen of no insignificant city. I beg you, allow me to speak to the people.”

21.zh: 千夫长准了。保罗就站在台阶上，向百姓摆手，他们都静默无声，保罗便用希伯来话对他们说：
21.en: When he had given him permission, Paul, standing on the stairs, beckoned with his hand to the people. When there was a great silence, he spoke to them in the Hebrew language, saying,

22.zh: 「诸位父兄请听，我现在对你们分诉。」
22.en: “Brothers and fathers, listen to the defense which I now make to you.”

22.zh: 众人听他说的是希伯来话，就更加安静了。
22.en: When they heard that he spoke to them in the Hebrew language, they were even more quiet. He said,

22.zh: 保罗说：「我原是犹太人，生在基利家的大数，长在这城里，在迦玛列门下，按着我们祖宗严紧的律法受教，热心事奉　神，像你们众人今日一样。
22.en: “I am indeed a Jew, born in Tarsus of Cilicia, but brought up in this city at the feet of Gamaliel, instructed according to the strict tradition of the law of our fathers, being zealous for God, even as you all are today.

22.zh: 我也曾逼迫奉这道的人，直到死地，无论男女都锁拿下监。
22.en: I persecuted this Way to the death, binding and delivering into prisons both men and women,

22.zh: 这是大祭司和众长老都可以给我作见证的。我又领了他们达与弟兄的书信，往大马士革去，要把在那里[奉这道]的人锁拿，带到耶路撒冷受刑。」
22.en: as also the high priest and all the council of the elders testify, from whom also I received letters to the brothers, and traveled to Damascus to bring them also who were there to Jerusalem in bonds to be punished.

22.zh: 「我将到大马士革，正走的时候，约在晌午，忽然从天上发大光，四面照着我。
22.en: “As I made my journey and came close to Damascus, about noon suddenly a great light shone around me from the sky.

22.zh: 我就仆倒在地，听见有声音对我说：『扫罗！扫罗！你为什么逼迫我？』
22.en: I fell to the ground and heard a voice saying to me, ‘Saul, Saul, why are you persecuting me?’

22.zh: 我回答说：『主啊，你是谁？』他说：『我就是你所逼迫的拿撒勒人耶稣。』
22.en: I answered, ‘Who are you, Lord?’ He said to me, ‘I am Jesus of Nazareth, whom you persecute.’

22.zh: 与我同行的人看见了那光，却没有听明那位对我说话的声音。
22.en: “Those who were with me indeed saw the light and were afraid, but they didn’t understand the voice of him who spoke to me.

22.zh: 我说：『主啊，我当做什么？』主说：『起来，进大马士革去，在那里，要将所派你做的一切事告诉你。』
22.en: I said, ‘What shall I do, Lord?’ The Lord said to me, ‘Arise, and go into Damascus. There you will be told about all things which are appointed for you to do.’

22.zh: 我因那光的荣耀不能看见，同行的人就拉着我手进了大马士革。
22.en: When I couldn’t see for the glory of that light, being led by the hand of those who were with me, I came into Damascus.

22.zh: 那[里]有一个人，名叫亚拿尼亚，按着律法是虔诚人，为一切住在那里的犹太人所称赞。
22.en: “One Ananias, a devout man according to the law, well reported of by all the Jews who lived in Damascus,

22.zh: 他来见我，站在旁边，对我说：『兄弟扫罗，你可以看见。』我当时往上一看，就看见了他。
22.en: came to me, and standing by me said to me, ‘Brother Saul, receive your sight!’ In that very hour I looked up at him.

22.zh: 他又说：『我们祖宗的　神拣选了你，叫你明白他的旨意，又得见那义者，听他口中所出的声音。
22.en: He said, ‘The God of our fathers has appointed you to know his will, and to see the Righteous One, and to hear a voice from his mouth.

22.zh: 因为你要将所看见的，所听见的，对着万人为他作见证。
22.en: For you will be a witness for him to all men of what you have seen and heard.

22.zh: 现在你为什么耽延呢？起来，求告他的名受洗，洗去你的罪。』」
22.en: Now why do you wait? Arise, be baptized, and wash away your sins, calling on the name of the Lord.’

22.zh: 「后来，我回到耶路撒冷，在殿里祷告的时候，魂游象外，
22.en: “When I had returned to Jerusalem and while I prayed in the temple, I fell into a trance

22.zh: 看见主向我说：『你赶紧地离开耶路撒冷，不可迟延；因你为我作的见证，这里的人必不领受。』
22.en: and saw him saying to me, ‘Hurry and get out of Jerusalem quickly, because they will not receive testimony concerning me from you.’

22.zh: 我就说：『主啊，他们知道我从前把信你的人收在监里，又在各会堂里鞭打他们。
22.en: I said, ‘Lord, they themselves know that I imprisoned and beat in every synagogue those who believed in you.

22.zh: 并且你的见证人司提反被害流血的时候，我也站在旁边欢喜；又看守害死他之人的衣裳。』
22.en: When the blood of Stephen, your witness, was shed, I also was standing by, consenting to his death, and guarding the cloaks of those who killed him.’

22.zh: 主向我说：『你去吧！我要差你远远地往外邦人那里去。』」
22.en: “He said to me, ‘Depart, for I will send you out far from here to the Gentiles.’ ”

22.zh: 众人听他说到这句话，就高声说：「这样的人，从世上除掉他吧！他是不当活着的。」
22.en: They listened to him until he said that; then they lifted up their voice and said, “Rid the earth of this fellow, for he isn’t fit to live!”

22.zh: 众人喧嚷，摔掉衣裳，把尘土向空中扬起来。
22.en: As they cried out, threw off their cloaks, and threw dust into the air,

22.zh: 千夫长就吩咐将保罗带进营楼去，叫人用鞭子拷问他，要知道他们向他这样喧嚷是为什么缘故。
22.en: the commanding officer commanded him to be brought into the barracks, ordering him to be examined by scourging, that he might know for what crime they shouted against him like that.

22.zh: 刚用皮条捆上，保罗对旁边站着的百夫长说：「人是罗马人，又没有定罪，你们就鞭打他，有这个例吗？」
22.en: When they had tied him up with straps, Paul asked the centurion who stood by, “Is it lawful for you to scourge a man who is a Roman, and not found guilty?”

22.zh: 百夫长听见这话，就去见千夫长，告诉他说：「你要做什么？这人是罗马人。」
22.en: When the centurion heard it, he went to the commanding officer and told him, “Watch what you are about to do, for this man is a Roman!”

22.zh: 千夫长就来问保罗说：「你告诉我，你是罗马人吗？」保罗说：「是。」
22.en: The commanding officer came and asked him, “Tell me, are you a Roman?” He said, “Yes.”

22.zh: 千夫长说：「我用许多银子才入了罗马的民籍。」保罗说：「我生来就是。」
22.en: The commanding officer answered, “I bought my citizenship for a great price.” Paul said, “But I was born a Roman.”

22.zh: 于是那些要拷问保罗的人就离开他去了。千夫长既知道他是罗马人，又因为捆绑了他，也害怕了。
22.en: Immediately those who were about to examine him departed from him, and the commanding officer also was afraid when he realized that he was a Roman, because he had bound him.

22.zh: 第二天，千夫长为要知道犹太人控告保罗的实情，便解开他，吩咐祭司长和全公会的人都聚集，将保罗带下来，叫他站在他们面前。
22.en: But on the next day, desiring to know the truth about why he was accused by the Jews, he freed him from the bonds and commanded the chief priests and all the council to come together, and brought Paul down and set him before them.

23.zh: 保罗定睛看着公会的人，说：「弟兄们，我在　神面前行事为人都是凭着良心，直到今日。」
23.en: Paul, looking steadfastly at the council, said, “Brothers, I have lived before God in all good conscience until today.”

23.zh: 大祭司亚拿尼亚就吩咐旁边站着的人打他的嘴。
23.en: The high priest, Ananias, commanded those who stood by him to strike him on the mouth.

23.zh: 保罗对他说：「你这粉饰的墙，　神要打你！你坐堂为的是按律法审问我，你竟违背律法，吩咐人打我吗？」
23.en: Then Paul said to him, “God will strike you, you whitewashed wall! Do you sit to judge me according to the law, and command me to be struck contrary to the law?”

23.zh: 站在旁边的人说：「你辱骂　神的大祭司吗？」
23.en: Those who stood by said, “Do you malign God’s high priest?”

23.zh: 保罗说：「弟兄们，我不晓得他是大祭司；[经上]记着说：『不可毁谤你百姓的官长。』」
23.en: Paul said, “I didn’t know, brothers, that he was high priest. For it is written, ‘You shall not speak evil of a ruler of your people.’”

23.zh: 保罗看出大众一半是撒都该人，一半是法利赛人，就在公会中大声说：「弟兄们，我是法利赛人，也是法利赛人的子孙。我现在受审问，是为盼望死人复活。」
23.en: But when Paul perceived that the one part were Sadducees and the other Pharisees, he cried out in the council, “Men and brothers, I am a Pharisee, a son of Pharisees. Concerning the hope and resurrection of the dead I am being judged!”

23.zh: 说了这话，法利赛人和撒都该人就争论起来，会众分为两党。
23.en: When he had said this, an argument arose between the Pharisees and Sadducees, and the crowd was divided.

23.zh: 因为撒都该人说，没有复活，也没有天使和鬼魂；法利赛人却说，两样都有。
23.en: For the Sadducees say that there is no resurrection, nor angel, nor spirit; but the Pharisees confess all of these.

23.zh: 于是大大地喧嚷起来。有几个法利赛党的文士站起来争辩说：「我们看不出这人有什么恶处，倘若有鬼魂或是天使对他说过话，怎么样呢？」
23.en: A great clamor arose, and some of the scribes of the Pharisees’ part stood up, and contended, saying, “We find no evil in this man. But if a spirit or angel has spoken to him, let’s not fight against God!”

23.zh: 那时大起争吵，千夫长恐怕保罗被他们扯碎了，就吩咐兵丁下去，把他从众人当中抢出来，带进营楼去。
23.en: When a great argument arose, the commanding officer, fearing that Paul would be torn in pieces by them, commanded the soldiers to go down and take him by force from among them and bring him into the barracks.

23.zh: 当夜，主站在保罗旁边，说：「放心吧！你怎样在耶路撒冷为我作见证，也必怎样在罗马[为我]作见证。」
23.en: The following night, the Lord stood by him and said, “Cheer up, Paul, for as you have testified about me at Jerusalem, so you must testify also at Rome.”

23.zh: 到了天亮，犹太人同谋起誓，说：「若不先杀保罗就不吃不喝。」
23.en: When it was day, some of the Jews banded together and bound themselves under a curse, saying that they would neither eat nor drink until they had killed Paul.

23.zh: 这样同心起誓的有四十多人。
23.en: There were more than forty people who had made this conspiracy.

23.zh: 他们来见祭司长和长老，说：「我们已经起了一个大誓，若不先杀保罗就不吃什么。
23.en: They came to the chief priests and the elders, and said, “We have bound ourselves under a great curse to taste nothing until we have killed Paul.

23.zh: 现在你们和公会要知会千夫长，叫他带下保罗到你们这里来，假作要详细察考他的事；我们已经预备好了，不等他来到跟前就杀他。」
23.en: Now therefore, you with the council inform the commanding officer that he should bring him down to you tomorrow, as though you were going to judge his case more exactly. We are ready to kill him before he comes near.”

23.zh: 保罗的外甥听见他们设下埋伏，就来到营楼里告诉保罗。
23.en: But Paul’s sister’s son heard they were lying in wait, and he came and entered into the barracks and told Paul.

23.zh: 保罗请一个百夫长来，说：「你领这少年人去见千夫长，他有事告诉他。」
23.en: Paul summoned one of the centurions and said, “Bring this young man to the commanding officer, for he has something to tell him.”

23.zh: 于是把他领去见千夫长，说：「被囚的保罗请我到他那里，求我领这少年人来见你；他有事告诉你。」
23.en: So he took him and brought him to the commanding officer and said, “Paul, the prisoner, summoned me and asked me to bring this young man to you. He has something to tell you.”

23.zh: 千夫长就拉着他的手，走到一旁，私下问他说：「你有什么事告诉我呢？」
23.en: The commanding officer took him by the hand, and going aside, asked him privately, “What is it that you have to tell me?”

23.zh: 他说：「犹太人已经约定，要求你明天带下保罗到公会里去，假作要详细查问他的事。
23.en: He said, “The Jews have agreed to ask you to bring Paul down to the council tomorrow, as though intending to inquire somewhat more accurately concerning him.

23.zh: 你切不要随从他们；因为他们有四十多人埋伏，已经起誓说，若不先杀保罗就不吃不喝。现在预备好了，只等你应允。」
23.en: Therefore don’t yield to them, for more than forty men lie in wait for him, who have bound themselves under a curse to neither eat nor drink until they have killed him. Now they are ready, looking for the promise from you.”

23.zh: 于是千夫长打发少年人走，嘱咐他说：「不要告诉人你将这事报给我了。」
23.en: So the commanding officer let the young man go, charging him, “Tell no one that you have revealed these things to me.”

23.zh: 千夫长便叫了两个百夫长来，说：「预备步兵二百，马兵七十，长枪手二百，今夜亥初往凯撒利亚去；
23.en: He called to himself two of the centurions, and said, “Prepare two hundred soldiers to go as far as Caesarea, with seventy horsemen and two hundred men armed with spears, at the third hour of the night.”

23.zh: 也要预备牲口叫保罗骑上，护送到巡抚腓力斯那里去。」
23.en: He asked them to provide mounts, that they might set Paul on one, and bring him safely to Felix the governor.

23.zh: 千夫长又写了文书，
23.en: He wrote a letter like this:

23.zh: 大略说：「克劳第·吕西亚，请巡抚腓力斯大人安。
23.en: “Claudius Lysias to the most excellent governor Felix: Greetings.

23.zh: 这人被犹太人拿住，将要杀害，我得知他是罗马人，就带兵丁下去救他出来。
23.en: “This man was seized by the Jews, and was about to be killed by them when I came with the soldiers and rescued him, having learned that he was a Roman.

23.zh: 因要知道他们告他的缘故，我就带他下到他们的公会去，
23.en: Desiring to know the cause why they accused him, I brought him down to their council.

23.zh: 便查知他被告是因他们律法的辩论，并没有什么该死该绑的罪名。
23.en: I found him to be accused about questions of their law, but not to be charged with anything worthy of death or of imprisonment.

23.zh: 后来有人把要害他的计谋告诉我，我就立时解他到你那里去，又吩咐告他的人在你面前告他。」
23.en: When I was told that the Jews lay in wait for the man, I sent him to you immediately, charging his accusers also to bring their accusations against him before you. Farewell.”

23.zh: 于是，兵丁照所吩咐他们的，将保罗夜里带到安提帕底。
23.en: So the soldiers, carrying out their orders, took Paul and brought him by night to Antipatris.

23.zh: 第二天，让马兵护送，他们就回营楼去。
23.en: But on the next day they left the horsemen to go with him, and returned to the barracks.

23.zh: 马兵来到凯撒利亚，把文书呈给巡抚，便叫保罗站在他面前。
23.en: When they came to Caesarea and delivered the letter to the governor, they also presented Paul to him.

23.zh: 巡抚看了文书，问保罗是哪省的人，既晓得他是基利家人，
23.en: When the governor had read it, he asked what province he was from. When he understood that he was from Cilicia, he said,

23.zh: 就说：「等告你的人来到，我要细听你的事」；便吩咐人把他看守在希律的衙门里。
23.en: “I will hear you fully when your accusers also arrive.” He commanded that he be kept in Herod’s palace.

24.zh: 过了五天，大祭司亚拿尼亚同几个长老，和一个辩士帖土罗下来，向巡抚控告保罗。
24.en: After five days, the high priest, Ananias, came down with certain elders and an orator, one Tertullus. They informed the governor against Paul.

24.zh: 保罗被提了来，帖土罗就告他说：
24.en: When he was called, Tertullus began to accuse him, saying, “Seeing that by you we enjoy much peace, and that prosperity is coming to this nation by your foresight,

24.zh: 「腓力斯大人，我们因你得以大享太平，并且这一国的弊病，因着你的先见得以更正了；我们随时随地满心感谢不尽。
24.en: we accept it in all ways and in all places, most excellent Felix, with all thankfulness.

24.zh: 惟恐多说，你嫌烦絮，只求你宽容听我们说几句话。
24.en: But that I don’t delay you, I entreat you to bear with us and hear a few words.

24.zh: 我们看这个人，如同瘟疫一般，是鼓动普天下众犹太人生乱的，又是拿撒勒教党里的一个头目，
24.en: For we have found this man to be a plague, an instigator of insurrections among all the Jews throughout the world, and a ringleader of the sect of the Nazarenes.

24.zh: -连[圣]殿他也想要污秽；我们把他捉住了。
24.en: He even tried to profane the temple, and we arrested him.

24.zh: 你自己究问他，就可以知道我们告他的一切事了。」
24.en: By examining him yourself you may ascertain all these things of which we accuse him.”

24.zh: 众犹太人也随着告他说：「事情诚然是这样。」
24.en: The Jews also joined in the attack, affirming that these things were so.

24.zh: 巡抚点头叫保罗说话。他就说：「我知道你在这国里断事多年，所以我乐意为自己分诉。
24.en: When the governor had beckoned to him to speak, Paul answered, “Because I know that you have been a judge of this nation for many years, I cheerfully make my defense,

24.zh: 你查问就可以知道，从我上耶路撒冷礼拜到今日不过有十二天。
24.en: seeing that you can verify that it is not more than twelve days since I went up to worship at Jerusalem.

24.zh: 他们并没有看见我在殿里，或是在会堂里，或是在城里，和人辩论，耸动众人。
24.en: In the temple they didn’t find me disputing with anyone or stirring up a crowd, either in the synagogues or in the city.

24.zh: 他们现在所告我的事并不能对你证实了。
24.en: Nor can they prove to you the things of which they now accuse me.

24.zh: 但有一件事，我向你承认，就是他们所称为异端的道，我正按着那道事奉我祖宗的　神，又信合乎[律法]的和[先知书]上一切所记载的，
24.en: But this I confess to you, that according to the Way, which they call a sect, so I serve the God of our fathers, believing all things which are according to the law, and which are written in the prophets;

24.zh: 并且靠着　神，盼望死人，无论善恶，都要复活，就是他们自己也有这个盼望。
24.en: having hope toward God, which these also themselves look for, that there will be a resurrection of the dead, both of the just and unjust.

24.zh: 我因此自己勉励，对　神对人，常存无亏的良心。
24.en: In this I also practice always having a conscience void of offense toward God and men.

24.zh: 过了几年，我带着周济本国的捐项和供献的物上去。
24.en: Now after some years, I came to bring gifts for the needy to my nation, and offerings;

24.zh: 正献的时候，他们看见我在殿里已经洁净了，并没有聚众，也没有吵嚷，惟有几个从亚细亚来的犹太人。
24.en: amid which certain Jews from Asia found me purified in the temple, not with a mob, nor with turmoil.

24.zh: 他们若有告我的事，就应当到你面前来告我。
24.en: They ought to have been here before you and to make accusation if they had anything against me.

24.zh: 即或不然，这些人若看出我站在公会前，有妄为的地方，他们自己也可以说明。
24.en: Or else let these men themselves say what injustice they found in me when I stood before the council,

24.zh: 纵然有，也不过一句话，就是我站在他们中间大声说：『我今日在你们面前受审，是为死人复活[的道理]。』」
24.en: unless it is for this one thing that I cried standing among them, ‘Concerning the resurrection of the dead I am being judged before you today!’”

24.zh: 腓力斯本是详细晓得这道，就支吾他们说：「且等千夫长吕西亚下来，我要审断你们的事。」
24.en: But Felix, having more exact knowledge concerning the Way, deferred them, saying, “When Lysias, the commanding officer, comes down, I will decide your case.”

24.zh: 于是吩咐百夫长看守保罗，并且宽待他，也不拦阻他的亲友来供给他。
24.en: He ordered the centurion that Paul should be kept in custody and should have some privileges, and not to forbid any of his friends to serve him or to visit him.

24.zh: 过了几天，腓力斯和他夫人—犹太的女子土西拉—一同来到，就叫了保罗来，听他讲论信基督耶稣的道。
24.en: After some days, Felix came with Drusilla his wife, who was a Jewess, and sent for Paul and heard him concerning the faith in Christ Jesus.

24.zh: 保罗讲论公义、节制，和将来的审判。腓力斯甚觉恐惧，说：「你暂且去吧，等我得便再叫你来。」
24.en: As he reasoned about righteousness, self-control, and the judgment to come, Felix was terrified, and answered, “Go your way for this time, and when it is convenient for me, I will summon you.”

24.zh: 腓力斯又指望保罗送他银钱，所以屡次叫他来，和他谈论。
24.en: Meanwhile, he also hoped that money would be given to him by Paul, that he might release him. Therefore also he sent for him more often and talked with him.

24.zh: 过了两年，波求·非斯都接了腓力斯的任；腓力斯要讨犹太人的喜欢，就留保罗在监里。
24.en: But when two years were fulfilled, Felix was succeeded by Porcius Festus, and desiring to gain favor with the Jews, Felix left Paul in bonds.

25.zh: 非斯都到了任，过了三天，就从凯撒利亚上耶路撒冷去。
25.en: Festus therefore, having come into the province, after three days went up to Jerusalem from Caesarea.

25.zh: 祭司长和犹太人的首领向他控告保罗，
25.en: Then the high priest and the principal men of the Jews informed him against Paul, and they begged him,

25.zh: 又央告他，求他的情，将保罗提到耶路撒冷来，他们要在路上埋伏杀害他。
25.en: asking a favor against him, that he would summon him to Jerusalem, plotting to kill him on the way.

25.zh: 非斯都却回答说：「保罗押在凯撒利亚，我自己快要往那里去」；
25.en: However Festus answered that Paul should be kept in custody at Caesarea, and that he himself was about to depart shortly.

25.zh: 又说：「你们中间有权势的人与我一同下去，那人若有什么不是，就可以告他。」
25.en: “Let them therefore”, he said, “that are in power among you go down with me, and if there is anything wrong in the man, let them accuse him.”

25.zh: 非斯都在他们那里住了不过十天八天，就下凯撒利亚去；第二天坐堂，吩咐将保罗提上来。
25.en: When he had stayed among them more than ten days, he went down to Caesarea, and on the next day he sat on the judgment seat, and commanded Paul to be brought.

25.zh: 保罗来了，那些从耶路撒冷下来的犹太人周围站着，将许多重大的事控告他，都是不能证实的。
25.en: When he had come, the Jews who had come down from Jerusalem stood around him, bringing against him many and grievous charges which they could not prove,

25.zh: 保罗分诉说：「无论犹太人的律法，或是[圣]殿，或是凯撒，我都没有干犯。」
25.en: while he said in his defense, “Neither against the law of the Jews, nor against the temple, nor against Caesar, have I sinned at all.”

25.zh: 但非斯都要讨犹太人的喜欢，就问保罗说：「你愿意上耶路撒冷去，在那里听我审断这事吗？」
25.en: But Festus, desiring to gain favor with the Jews, answered Paul and said, “Are you willing to go up to Jerusalem and be judged by me there concerning these things?”

25.zh: 保罗说：「我站在凯撒的堂前，这就是我应当受审的地方。我向犹太人并没有行过什么不义的事，这也是你明明知道的。
25.en: But Paul said, “I am standing before Caesar’s judgment seat, where I ought to be tried. I have done no wrong to the Jews, as you also know very well.

25.zh: 我若行了不义的事，犯了什么该死的罪，就是死，我也不辞。他们所告我的事若都不实，就没有人可以把我交给他们。我要上告于凯撒。」
25.en: For if I have done wrong and have committed anything worthy of death, I don’t refuse to die; but if none of those things is true that they accuse me of, no one can give me up to them. I appeal to Caesar!”

25.zh: 非斯都和议会商量了，就说：「你既上告于凯撒，可以往凯撒那里去。」
25.en: Then Festus, when he had conferred with the council, answered, “You have appealed to Caesar. To Caesar you shall go.”

25.zh: 过了些日子，亚基帕王和百妮基氏来到凯撒利亚，问非斯都安。
25.en: Now when some days had passed, King Agrippa and Bernice arrived at Caesarea and greeted Festus.

25.zh: 在那里住了多日，非斯都将保罗的事告诉王，说：「这里有一个人，是腓力斯留在监里的。
25.en: As he stayed there many days, Festus laid Paul’s case before the king, saying, “There is a certain man left a prisoner by Felix;

25.zh: 我在耶路撒冷的时候，祭司长和犹太的长老将他的事禀报了我，求我定他的罪。
25.en: about whom, when I was at Jerusalem, the chief priests and the elders of the Jews informed me, asking for a sentence against him.

25.zh: 我对他们说，无论什么人，被告还没有和原告对质，未得机会分诉所告他的事，就先定他的罪，这不是罗马人的条例。
25.en: I answered them that it is not the custom of the Romans to give up any man to destruction before the accused has met the accusers face to face and has had opportunity to make his defense concerning the matter laid against him.

25.zh: 及至他们都来到这里，我就不耽延，第二天便坐堂，吩咐把那人提上来。
25.en: When therefore they had come together here, I didn’t delay, but on the next day sat on the judgment seat and commanded the man to be brought.

25.zh: 告他的人站着告他；所告的，并没有我所逆料的那等恶事。
25.en: When the accusers stood up, they brought no charges against him of such things as I supposed;

25.zh: 不过是有几样辩论，为他们自己敬鬼神的事，又为一个人名叫耶稣，是已经死了，保罗却说他是活着的。
25.en: but had certain questions against him about their own religion and about one Jesus, who was dead, whom Paul affirmed to be alive.

25.zh: 这些事当怎样究问，我心里作难，所以问他说：『你愿意上耶路撒冷去，在那里为这些事听审吗？』
25.en: Being perplexed how to inquire concerning these things, I asked whether he was willing to go to Jerusalem and there be judged concerning these matters.

25.zh: 但保罗求我留下他，要听皇上审断，我就吩咐把他留下，等我解他到凯撒那里去。」
25.en: But when Paul had appealed to be kept for the decision of the emperor, I commanded him to be kept until I could send him to Caesar.”

25.zh: 亚基帕对非斯都说：「我自己也愿听这人辩论。」非斯都说：「明天你可以听。」
25.en: Agrippa said to Festus, “I also would like to hear the man myself.” “Tomorrow,” he said, “you shall hear him.”

25.zh: 第二天，亚基帕和百妮基大张威势而来，同着众千夫长和城里的尊贵人进了公厅。非斯都吩咐一声，就有人将保罗带进来。
25.en: So on the next day, when Agrippa and Bernice had come with great pomp, and they had entered into the place of hearing with the commanding officers and the principal men of the city, at the command of Festus, Paul was brought in.

25.zh: 非斯都说：「亚基帕王和在这里的诸位啊，你们看这人，就是一切犹太人，在耶路撒冷和这里，曾向我恳求、呼叫说：『不可容他再活着。』
25.en: Festus said, “King Agrippa, and all men who are here present with us, you see this man about whom all the multitude of the Jews petitioned me, both at Jerusalem and here, crying that he ought not to live any longer.

25.zh: 但我查明他没有犯什么该死的罪，并且他自己上告于皇帝，所以我定意把他解去。
25.en: But when I found that he had committed nothing worthy of death, and as he himself appealed to the emperor, I determined to send him,

25.zh: 论到这人，我没有确实的事可以奏明主上。因此，我带他到你们面前，也特意带他到你亚基帕王面前，为要在查问之后有所陈奏。
25.en: of whom I have no certain thing to write to my lord. Therefore I have brought him out before you, and especially before you, King Agrippa, that, after examination I may have something to write.

25.zh: 据我看来，解送囚犯，不指明他的罪案是不合理的。」
25.en: For it seems to me unreasonable, in sending a prisoner, not to also specify the charges against him.”

26.zh: 亚基帕对保罗说：「准你为自己辩明。」于是保罗伸手分诉，说：「
26.en: Agrippa said to Paul, “You may speak for yourself.” Then Paul stretched out his hand, and made his defense.

26.zh: 亚基帕王啊，犹太人所告我的一切事，今日得在你面前分诉，实为万幸；
26.en: “I think myself happy, King Agrippa, that I am to make my defense before you today concerning all the things that I am accused by the Jews,

26.zh: 更可幸的，是你熟悉犹太人的规矩和他们的辩论；所以求你耐心听我。
26.en: especially because you are expert in all customs and questions which are among the Jews. Therefore I beg you to hear me patiently.

26.zh: 我从起初在本国的民中，并在耶路撒冷，自幼为人如何，犹太人都知道。
26.en: “Indeed, all the Jews know my way of life from my youth up, which was from the beginning among my own nation and at Jerusalem;

26.zh: 他们若肯作见证就晓得，我从起初是按着我们教中最严紧的教门作了法利赛人。
26.en: having known me from the first, if they are willing to testify, that after the strictest sect of our religion I lived a Pharisee.

26.zh: 现在我站在这里受审，是因为指望　神向我们祖宗所应许的；
26.en: Now I stand here to be judged for the hope of the promise made by God to our fathers,

26.zh: 这应许，我们十二个支派，昼夜切切地事奉　[神]，都指望得着。王啊，我被犹太人控告，就是因这指望。
26.en: which our twelve tribes, earnestly serving night and day, hope to attain. Concerning this hope I am accused by the Jews, King Agrippa!

26.zh: 神叫死人复活，你们为什么看作不可信的呢？
26.en: Why is it judged incredible with you if God does raise the dead?

26.zh: 从前我自己以为应当多方攻击拿撒勒人耶稣的名，
26.en: “I myself most certainly thought that I ought to do many things contrary to the name of Jesus of Nazareth.

26.zh: 我在耶路撒冷也曾这样行了。既从祭司长得了权柄，我就把许多圣徒囚在监里。他们被杀，我也出名定案。
26.en: I also did this in Jerusalem. I both shut up many of the saints in prisons, having received authority from the chief priests; and when they were put to death I gave my vote against them.

26.zh: 在各会堂，我屡次用刑强逼他们说亵渎的话，又分外恼恨他们，甚至追逼他们，直到外邦的城邑。」
26.en: Punishing them often in all the synagogues, I tried to make them blaspheme. Being exceedingly enraged against them, I persecuted them even to foreign cities.

26.zh: 「那时，我领了祭司长的权柄和命令，往大马士革去。
26.en: “Whereupon as I traveled to Damascus with the authority and commission from the chief priests,

26.zh: 王啊，我在路上，晌午的时候，看见从天发光，比日头还亮，四面照着我并与我同行的人。
26.en: at noon, O king, I saw on the way a light from the sky, brighter than the sun, shining around me and those who traveled with me.

26.zh: 我们都仆倒在地，我就听见有声音用希伯来话向我说：『扫罗！扫罗！为什么逼迫我？你用脚踢刺是难的！』
26.en: When we had all fallen to the earth, I heard a voice saying to me in the Hebrew language, ‘Saul, Saul, why are you persecuting me? It is hard for you to kick against the goads.’

26.zh: 我说：『主啊，你是谁？』主说：『我就是你所逼迫的耶稣。
26.en: “I said, ‘Who are you, Lord?’ “He said, ‘I am Jesus, whom you are persecuting.

26.zh: 你起来站着，我特意向你显现，要派你作执事，作见证，将你所看见的事和我将要指示你的事证明出来。
26.en: But arise, and stand on your feet, for I have appeared to you for this purpose: to appoint you a servant and a witness both of the things which you have seen and of the things which I will reveal to you;

26.zh: 我也要救你脱离百姓和外邦人的手。
26.en: delivering you from the people and from the Gentiles, to whom I send you,

26.zh: 我差你到他们那里去，要叫他们的眼睛得开，从黑暗中归向光明，从撒但权下归向　神；又因信我，得蒙赦罪，和一切成圣的人同得基业。』」
26.en: to open their eyes, that they may turn from darkness to light and from the power of Satan to God, that they may receive remission of sins and an inheritance among those who are sanctified by faith in me.’

26.zh: 「亚基帕王啊，我故此没有违背那从天上来的异象；
26.en: “Therefore, King Agrippa, I was not disobedient to the heavenly vision,

26.zh: 先在大马士革，后在耶路撒冷和犹太全地，以及外邦，劝勉他们应当悔改归向　神，行事与悔改的心相称。
26.en: but declared first to them of Damascus, at Jerusalem, and throughout all the country of Judea, and also to the Gentiles, that they should repent and turn to God, doing works worthy of repentance.

26.zh: 因此，犹太人在殿里拿住我，想要杀我。
26.en: For this reason the Jews seized me in the temple and tried to kill me.

26.zh: 然而我蒙　神的帮助，直到今日还站得住，对着尊贵、卑贱、老幼作见证；所讲的并不外乎众先知和摩西所说将来必成的事，
26.en: Having therefore obtained the help that is from God, I stand to this day testifying both to small and great, saying nothing but what the prophets and Moses said would happen,

26.zh: 就是基督必须受害，并且因从死里复活，要首先把光明的道传给百姓和外邦人。」
26.en: how the Christ must suffer, and how, by the resurrection of the dead, he would be first to proclaim light both to these people and to the Gentiles.”

26.zh: 保罗这样分诉，非斯都大声说：「保罗，你癫狂了吧。你的学问太大，反叫你癫狂了！」
26.en: As he thus made his defense, Festus said with a loud voice, “Paul, you are crazy! Your great learning is driving you insane!”

26.zh: 保罗说：「非斯都大人，我不是癫狂，我说的乃是真实明白话。
26.en: But he said, “I am not crazy, most excellent Festus, but boldly declare words of truth and reasonableness.

26.zh: 王也晓得这些事，所以我向王放胆直言，我深信这些事没有一件向王隐藏的，因都不是在背地里做的。
26.en: For the king knows of these things, to whom also I speak freely. For I am persuaded that none of these things is hidden from him, for this has not been done in a corner.

26.zh: 亚基帕王啊，你信先知吗？我知道你是信的。」
26.en: King Agrippa, do you believe the prophets? I know that you believe.”

26.zh: 亚基帕对保罗说：「你想少微一劝，便叫我作基督徒啊！」
26.en: Agrippa said to Paul, “With a little persuasion are you trying to make me a Christian?”

26.zh: 保罗说：「无论是少劝是多劝，我向　神所求的，不但你一个人，就是今天一切听我的，都要像我一样，只是不要像我有这些锁链。」
